items.title: Guess Who They Miss Now
items.intro: Samantha, the high school basketball team manager, is framed and killed. Reborn at the moment when suspicion first arose, Samantha makes a different choice: she leaves the basketball team and joins the ice hockey team, where she finally discovers her own worth. Only then does the basketball team realize how indispensable she was—but by then, it is far too late.

items.title: Fear Her, My Mom's the Lady Boss!
items.intro: Claire suffers constant abuse from her fiancé and his family, never knowing that her mother, whom she believes is only a janitor, is actually Lady Thunder—the legendary founder of a trillion-dollar empire. When her daughter is pushed to the brink, Lady Thunder returns from hiding to crush her enemies, expose impostors, and reclaim her throne. But when a fake heiress steals Claire's identity, an explosive battle for power, family, and revenge begins.

items.title: Lady Diamond's Lost Heiress Returns
items.intro: To save her mother Maria, young Bella Rossi sacrifices herself to the mafia. Twenty years later, Maria has become "Lady Diamond," a powerful mogul searching for her lost child. Meanwhile, Bella is betrayed at her own wedding by her fiancé, Vince, who steals her savings to marry another woman. When Maria recognizes Bella's birthmark while Bella is being humiliated at her wedding,  she unleashes her power to protect her daughter and crush their enemies.

items.title: No Escape as the Dragon King's Mate
items.intro: On a rainy Valentine's night, Lydia, a human nurse, saves a bleeding stranger, only to discover he's Soren—the ruthless Dragon King. His ultimatum is brutal: become his fated mate or die. Dragged into a lethal supernatural world, Lydia finds her defiance melting into burning desire as she glimpses the vulnerable heart beneath the tyrant's scales. With the 30-day contract ending, will she claim her freedom, or surrender to the Dragon King forever?

items.title: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom
items.intro: After PTA (Parent Teacher Association) moms target and frame her son, a "nobody" mom is humiliated and cast aside—as an even bigger secret unfolds behind the scenes... until they discover she's the secret billionaire behind the school. Now, she decides their fate.

items.title: Ruling Over All I See (DUBBED)
items.intro: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

items.title: I'm Nothing but a Mortal (DUBBED)
items.intro: Ian Colt, a genius Jade Sect apprentice, ascends to the Sky Realm after just 20 years of cultivation. Believing there's nothing more to teach him, his mentor, Sean Judd, tricks Ian into leaving for the mortal realm.There, Ian encounters Jim Cole, whose life is on the line. Despite the efforts of three skilled doctors, none can save him, leaving his daughter, Sue Cole, desperate. Ian successfully saves Jim.

items.title: Forever Was a Lie
items.intro: Nicole Quinn is taken in by her mother’s best friend after her family goes bankrupt, beginning a 20-year bond with Colin and Abel from the Smith family. The brothers dote on Nicole, but everything changes when the nanny’s daughter, Mandy Moore, enters the picture. Nicole becomes the target of Mandy’s schemes and humiliation, placing her in a difficult situation where the Smith brothers start distancing themselves and lose interest in her.

items.title: Queen Mom Rules
items.intro: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift is called fake, and she's even banned from the table!

items.title: Divorced, Now a Lycan Princess
items.intro: After being cast aside by her powerful Alpha husband and forced to conceal her miraculous pregnancy, a seemingly ordinary human woman discovers she is actually the long-lost Lycan Princess. As her secret identity awakens, she reclaims her power, exposes betrayal, and challenges the ruthless werewolf hierarchy—not just to protect her unborn child, but to decide her own fate.

items.title: Pucked by My Brother's Rival
items.intro:
Good girl Jenny's first rule? Never sleep with the enemy -especially not Xavier, her brother Samuel's rival and the league's most insatiable player. But when he catches her mid-fantasy with his nude photo between her thighs, rules shatter faster than the headboard in his bedroom. Facing Xavier's relentless pursuit, the closet, the bathroom, and her exclusive lingerie...
Now they're playing a dangerous game of ‘pretend we’re not fucking’—and Samuel is about to find out.

items.title: Watch Out, I'm The Lady Boss
items.intro: After being cast aside by the man she helped rise to power, Eleanor—secret CEO of the powerful Thunder Circle—is thrust back into the spotlight when a mysterious billionaire proposes marriage, shaking high society to its core.

items.title: Fake Dating My Rich Nemesis
items.intro: When a sassy high school girl returns to North Lake High, she doesn't expect to have a one-night mistake with the Beaumont heir, her childhood nemesis, and later team up with him to piss off their exes. Will they eventually fall in love?

items.title: Addicted to Your Kiss
items.intro: Ruth Larson's family sells her off to Logan Harlow for money. He icily says that he won't touch her. But when they run into each other at the club, he downs her alcohol in a jealous fit. Ruth asks him to mind himself. But he responds in an aggrieved tone, "Why? Are you scared of others finding out you're married?" This confuses Ruth. Didn't he say they would be divorced in a month? What is he playing at now?

items.title: One Fateful Night with My Boss
items.intro: After having a one-night stand with an old geezer for money, Anita said goodbye to this cold city and went abroad. Six years later, she comes back with her son and bumps into the legendary CEO, Tristan, who later turns out to be her new boss. Before she knows it, her son starts calling this handsome new boss: “dad”. Could this be fate?

items.title: Reveal, Rise and Reign (DUBBED)
items.intro: Lance West generously supports his girlfriend, Lara Olson, throughout her academic journey. Thanks to his financial assistance, she successfully graduates and attains significant financial success, earning tens of millions annually. Despite Lance's unwavering support, Lara callously severs their relationship, citing the gap in their social statuses. However, in the wake of this heartbreak, fate intervenes.

items.title: The Wedding Day Divorce (DUBBED)
items.intro: On Tyson Jordan’s wedding day, his sister, Taylor, returns from abroad to celebrate, only to be mistaken by his fiancée for his secret pregnant lover. Despite Taylor's attempts to clarify the misunderstanding, the fiancée harbors resentment and deliberately causes Taylor's miscarriage. When Tyson learns the truth, he vows to seek revenge for his sister, compelling his fiancée’s family to face the consequences of her reckless actions.

items.title: I Became Mrs Grayson by Bragging
items.intro: On the day of the interview, Alice, an ordinary girl, saved the CEO of the Grayson pharmaceutical group, and bragged that she was the CEO's financee. Unexpectedly, the CEO not only asked her to be his personal assistant, but also married her in a flash.

items.title: Chosen by the Dragon Baby: His Human Mate
items.intro: After being betrayed, sold, and robbed of her newborn, Emery believes she has lost everything. A year later, she is accidentally saved from a human slaver by Alaric, the Dragon King, and serves as a maid in his palace. There, his silent daughter, Juno, rejects every shifter in the realm—but chooses Emery as "Mama." As Juno begins to heal and Alaric falls for Emery, the buried secrets reveal that their bond runs deeper than any of them imagined.

items.title: Done Being Your Spare Daughter!
items.intro: Switched at IVF, Maya was never wanted. Both families chose perfect Haley, while Maya got leftovers and a storage room. At 18, Maya was diagnosed with kidney failure—but her adoptive parents told her to die, and her biological parents begged her to spare Haley. Then the hospital called: the charts were swapped. Haley was the sick one. Now the family that abandoned Maya needs her kidney. But Maya is done being their spare daughter. Will she save them—or finally choose herself?

items.title: The Hidden Tyrant: A Retired Godfather Baking in Sicily
items.intro: Once Sicily's most feared godfather, Vito Rossi is reborn as Leo Moretti, a mafia heir who only wants to bake bread. To escape the throne, he spends years pretending to be a fool. But when a rival family's plot puts his loved ones in danger, Leo drops the act and unleashes the ruthless genius he tried to bury. As Sicily's four families turn on one another, can the hidden tyrant save his family without becoming the godfather again?

items.title: Offside Love
items.intro: Ethan has spent two years loving star quarterback Ryan in secret, hidden in equipment rooms and never allowed into the light. When a leaked photo exposes Ryan's betrayal, Ethan finally lets go. Noah, the quiet teammate who has secretly drawn him for years, steps forward instead. Choosing art and a love that never hides, Ethan finds his own stage.

items.title: Five Years of Hate, a Lifetime of Regret
items.intro: After her parents cause a drunk-driving accident that kills his family, mafia boss Dominic imprisons and tortures his innocent fiancée, Elena, for five years. When she finally throws herself into the river, he realizes too late that he loves her. But his regret comes too late. Some wounds never heal.

items.title: Rough Ride with My F1 Rival
items.intro: What happens when your biggest rival becomes your billionaire boss? F1 enemies Kyle and Chase clash fiercely on track. Drowning in debt, Kyle unknowingly signs on to be Chase's live-in training driver. Their hatred soon ignites into a secret romance. But when a malicious leak exposes their affair, Kyle faces an impossible choice: betray Chase to save his racing career, or stand by the rival who stole his heart.

items.title: The Hidden Princess at the All-Alpha Academy
items.intro:
One princess. Two fated mates. One secret that could ruin everything.
Fleeing a sinister arranged marriage, Princess Ariel disguises herself as a boy at an all-male Alpha Academy. But fate has a wild sense of humor: she finds not one, but TWO powerful Alphas as her mates—Luca and Jackson. 
With every heartbeat, her secret slips closer to exposure. Caught in an irresistible triangle, how can she choose when her heart and body want them both?

items.title: Falling for the Prince at Dark Arts Academy
items.intro: After demons slaughter her parents, Margo enters Edenfall Academy, an elite school ruled by the very creatures she hates. There, she's drawn to the dangerously seductive Prince Damien—without knowing he secretly bonded her the night of the massacre. But as forbidden desire grows, the angel blood hidden inside her could turn their forbidden connection into a threat to the entire kingdom.

items.title: I Wish It Were You
items.intro: Bound by a family alliance, Isabel found herself reluctantly married to a stranger named Jared. Despite being wed for a year, their encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. As Isabel navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss—the billionaire Lorenzo Bellini. Through a series of jaw-dropping twists, Isabel was stunned to discover that the captivating Lorenzo was, in fact, her husband Jared in name...

items.title: A Deal With My Billionaire Donor
items.intro: Claire Miller, desperate to have a child after being diagnosed with premature ovarian failure, vows to get pregnant before her ex’s new girlfriend gives birth. Enter Ethan Reed—a billionaire forced to marry or lose his inheritance. They strike a “sperm contract” for mutual benefit, but when Ethan becomes her new boss, sparks ignite and emotions blur. Can a fake marriage born of pride turn into real love?

items.title: It's Too Late to Apologize
items.intro:
Her husband accused her of trapping him. Her daughter wished for a different mom. Now she's gone.
After one last betrayal, Zoey signs the divorce papers and disappears.What will they do when they realize she's never coming back?

items.title: Legally Sexy and Mr. Ice Cold
items.intro: A one-night stand with billionaire Leo Whitney leaves law student Summer Ellis unexpectedly pregnant. Her toxic sister, Angie, steals Summer's identity and becomes Leo's fiancée. Six years later, Summer crosses paths with Leo again—this time with her five-year-old daughter, Melody. As Summer represents Leo in a custody case, the buried truth resurfaces, and love ignites.

items.title: Kissing the Wrong Brother
items.intro: To win the heart of her crush before graduation, nerd Aria enlists the help of his dangerously charming older brother for a crash course in intimacy—only to discover she might be learning how to love the wrong guy. She asks him for lessons in sex and intimacy. And her crush's brother becomes her love coach.

items.title: If I Never Loved You
items.intro: Five years ago, Elena sacrificed her heart to mysterious billionaire Victor for a 30 billion investment, saving Nolan's bankrupt family and his life, then lied about being money-driven to break up with him. Five years later, Nolan becomes a tycoon, engaged to Sophia, who actually plotted his family's downfall.

items.title: Your Billionaire Bride Is My Cheating Wife
items.intro: On his birthday, low-profile billionaire Anthony discovers his wife is marrying another man—using his identity, money, and status. Crashing the wedding as a “nobody,” he endures public humiliation until the truth erupts: he is the real CEO and Mafia King. As lies unravel, Anthony reclaims his power, exposing betrayal and delivering ruthless revenge.

items.title: Through Ashes Their Sorrow Awakens
items.intro: Ashley, the Langstons' biological daughter, spends years in prison after Lilith, the adopted daughter, frames her. When she gets out, her whole family—including her fiancé Ethan—still believes Lilith's lies and keeps hurting her. To make Lilith happy, Ethan even agrees to a fake wedding with her. On the day of their wedding, Ashley stages her own death in a fire and leaves for good. That's when they're shocked, panicked, and burning with regret.

items.title: The Vanished Champ Strikes Back
items.intro: An invincible fight king hides his identity, living life as a janitor, but shocking everyone with his true power when confronted with challenges.

items.title: Silence! Boss Lady Speaks
items.intro: Eleanor, a reclusive heiress returning from Africa, is mistaken for a penniless charity worker and publicly humiliated by her ex and his family. But when a mysterious CEO, Sebastian, sees something rare in her and proposes marriage, their union sends shockwaves through high society. As her enemies push too far, Eleanor fights back—revealing her true identity as Thunder Lady, the secret CEO of the world’s most powerful investment syndicate.

items.title: Revenge Puck
items.intro: Lucy has just been cheated on and dumped by her ex-boyfriend and hockey star Adam. She makes a deal to fake date his biggest hockey rival, Blake, to throw off his game until the end of the playoffs.

items.title: My Brother's Wrath Awaits
items.intro: After surviving an abusive mafia father, Aurora spends her life calming her volatile brother Lucian, now the city's most feared mafia boss, who violently punishes anyone who disturbs her peace. When Lucian's iancée mistakes Aurora for a maid and tortures her, Lucian is manipulated into hurting Aurora. As Aurora disappearsinto the underground black market, Lucian uncovers the devastating truth and unleashes his wrath on everyone responsible - even himself.

items.title: Wait! Our Great-Grandma is 18 Years Old?
items.intro: Cryonically revived and posing as a high school girl, 1950s legend Victoria Reed returns to protect her 70-year-old son Andrew and set the next generation straight—until the family learns the 'new girl' is their great-grandmother.

items.title: Move to Countryside, Marry a Billionaire!
items.intro: Forced into a marriage to save her adoptive father, Louise Mitchell leaves the city for the countryside, only to discover her "farmer" husband, Troy Scott, is actually a hidden billionaire. Bound by a three-month contract, their rocky start slowly transforms into trust and passion, as schemes, family conflicts, and secrets test their love.

items.title: Back to the 80s
items.intro: Julie Stein wakes up from her sleep, expecting just another ordinary day. However, to her surprise, she finds herself in the 80s, a totally different era from where she belongs. Not only is she a disowned daughter of a wealthy family to whom she has no blood connection, but she is also supposed to marry an old man with two children, in place of the family’s biological daughter.

items.title: Signed, Sealed, Secretly Married
items.intro: With the help of his grandfather, Dave Quinn marries Tessa Gray, a girl he does not know much about. After marriage, Tessa works in Quinn Corp as a cleaner and makes Dave promise to keep their relationship a secret from their colleagues. However, some of her colleagues show disdain towards her, especially Dave’s childhood sweetheart, Lana Harris, who has a crush on him. Out of jealousy, Lana sets Tessa up in an attempt to get rid of her, hoping to ruin her marriage with Dave.

items.title: Masked Magnate: The Dominant Son-in-Law (DUBBED)
items.intro: After being reunited with his biological father, Chris Bell assumes the CEO position at the Olgow branch of Apex Group. However, at his father-in-law's birthday party, he faces rejection from the family table, labeled as a useless live-in son-in-law. His challenges escalate as his wife faces disdain alongside him, a suitor tries to take her away, developers attempt to forcibly demolish their home, and his daughter falls victim to a brutal attack by a wealthy man.

items.title: What She Left Behind
items.intro: After being transported back to an ancient era, Isla Stern devotes herself to helping Shaun Laine, a downtrodden prince, rise to power and become a great emperor. She gives birth to their cherished son, Aaron Laine, and earns her place as a revered empress admired by all. However, years later, both her husband and son fall for Tanya Yale, betraying her trust and breaking her heart.

items.title: The Mafia's Obsession
items.intro: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.

items.title: When Forever Turns to Never
items.intro: Can you imagine being humiliated by your future stepmother at your father’s wedding, only to be mistaken for his mistress? In this story, Luna Ward seizes the moment of this misunderstanding and turns it into an opportunity to expose her stepmother. As the scandal stirs the crowd, Luna defends her dignity and protects her family. With Julian Ward’s unwavering support, they unleash their fury, putting an end to the disgrace once and for all.

items.title: Love's Detour to Destiny
items.intro: Mia Cole has been married to Joe Holt for three years when she catches him in bed with Sue Cole on the day of their third wedding anniversary. After seeking a divorce, Mia reclaims her title as the founder of MY Corp and overcomes Sue, resolving the misunderstandings between herself and Joe. Having gone through thick and thin together, they finally end up as a happy couple.

items.title: CEO’s Substitute Wife
items.intro: Framed and abandoned, Alice, the adopted daughter of the influential Dunn family, faced a relentless betrayal. Ariel, her long-lost twin, who walks in as Alice to seek vengeance. With the enigmatic Vincent by her side, Ariel navigates a treacherous path of deceit and danger. As their quest for retribution unfolds, dark secrets emerge, blurring the line between ally and enemy.

items.title: House Husband? Try Supreme Immortal
items.intro: Logan Bale, an immortal who has walked the earth for a thousand years, fulfills a dying promise to his disciple—to protect his family for three years. To honor that vow, he marries his disciple's granddaughter, only to be met with her family's scorn and cruelty. Yet undeterred, he endures their contempt with quiet resolve, holding fast to one promise of his own: to walk away the moment those three years come to an end.

items.title: Love, not Lost to Memory (DUBBED)
items.intro: After giving birth to twins for the powerful Todd family, Vera Bell is drained of her blood in the delivery room to save their chosen heir, Finn Todd—leaving her lifeless, clutching a blood-stained lucky charm. Seven years later, mute and stripped of her memory, Vera survives by scavenging while raising her daughter, Grace Bell.

items.title: The One That Got Away
items.intro: Bella, a prep-school queen, is betrayed when Louis uses her to chase her stepsister Vivian. She transfers to start over—until Louis learns the truth and fights to win her back.

items.title: Love Is A Dangerous Game
items.intro: Olivia is dragged by her husband Ryan to a couples-swapping getaway—only to be paired with Jake, the husband of her closest friend Mia. Jake is magnetic, unreadable, relentless—nothing like the dull, clueless husband Mia always described. And he won't stop closing in. As both men begin fighting for Olivia's attention, and Mia's jealousy cracks in her perfect act, Olivia must uncover the real truth behind the partner-swapping party before it's too late.

items.title: Deny Me, Dragon King
items.intro: Human Lyra stumbles on Dragon King Kael and shares a passionate night. Tricked by a fake prophecy, he casts her out—only for Lyra to bear his half-dragon daughter Amber. Years later, she returns seeking a healer to save her sick child. Old sparks reignite, jealous rivals plot, and hidden blood ties surface as they fight for their family and broken love.

items.title: Tempest：The Last Mecha
items.intro: Broken by his parents' deaths, Colt Thorne, the Mech King, hides as a lowly janitor after being saved by Freya. But when Freya, the woman he secretly loves, is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, Colt must unleash his hidden identity. Unlocking his legendary 100% Neural Sync, he commands The Tempest to crush his enemies and save the world from an extinction-level alien swarm!

items.title: 365 Days to Be Mine
items.intro: Architecture student Caspian is abducted by mafia don Aurelio, who gives him 365 days to fall in love. After witnessing his girlfriend's betrayal and surviving mafia conflicts, Caspian confronts his submissive desires, accepts Aurelio's collar, and becomes his devoted partner.

items.title: The Elf Queen's Choice
items.intro: Aethera, last Starlight Elf queen, wields Star Speech. On her betrothal eve, she catches fiancé Cassian with cousin Maeve. She shreds the pact, defies her clan, and chooses scorned half-elf bastard Kaelen—secret Shadow King of the overseas Dark Court, who waited fifteen years.A star contract binds them as allies. He offers all. Cassian kneels; Maeve’s mask falls. At the Great Star Rite, a void rift opens. He shields her with blood; her Star Speech fuses their souls......

items.title: Husbands in the Backseat
items.intro: A four-person road trip, two seemingly loving couples, hiding the dirtiest of secrets. Liam, a fitness trainer, and Ethan, a corporate CEO, are ex-lovers now married to other women, yet they rekindle their forbidden flame in the backseat.In the front, their unsuspecting wives; in the back, years of suppressed taboo. From intense on the coastal highway to extreme tension in a service station parking lot, Ethan closes in step by step while Liam retreats inch by inch......

items.title: Claimed by My Stepbrother
items.intro: The billionaire heir found his prey, only to discover he was his new stepbrother. In this forbidden hunt... who will fall first?

items.title: The Lion King Wants Only Me
items.intro: Veterinarian Ophelia falls through a rift into a beastman continent. Rescued by lion king Krig, she becomes the object of his fierce devotion. Through misunderstandings and jealousy, she earns the clan's respect with modern medicine—and stays to build a life with him.

items.title: The Vengeance of the Runway Queen
items.intro: Supermodel Celine is disfigured by her jealous agent/boyfriend Kyle. She secretly undergoes facial reconstruction, becomes designer "S", and returns five years later. At Paris Fashion Week, she exposes Kyle, acquires his company, and finds love with Lucas—the surgeon who healed her.

items.title: No Escape from My Alpha Professor
items.intro: Low-ranking Omega Liora stumbles into a werewolf academy sex party, where Anna drugs and humiliates her—yet she unexpectedly forms a mate bond with a future alpha. The next day, she notices the new professor, Ethan, looks strangely familiar. With no memory of that night, she falls step by step into Ethan's "punishment game." Jealous of the attention Ethan gives Liora, Anna escalates her bullying, even holding Liora underwater until she nearly drowns.

items.title: The Matriarch
items.intro: Victoria, Gray family matriarch, is held at gunpoint by her son’s mistress Monica, who mistakes her for Emily. Hiding her identity, she moves into the manor to investigate. She uncovers her son’s embezzlement and inheritance plot. Finally, she strips him of all assets and names Emily sole heir, shocking Monica at the dinner party.

items.title: My Clingy Succubus
items.intro: Arthur, a magicless noble outcast rejected by a direwolf, obtains the All-Heaven Beast Restoration System. He rescues dying succubus Lilith and forms a soul pact. Together they overcome academy plots, demon tides. Arthur sacrifices his system core, defeats the Archdemon, and rules mortal and abyss realms with Lilith.

items.title: He Was Never Just a Nobody
items.intro: Adrian Carter hides his wealth and returns home to surprise his wife, Claire Parker. For three years, Claire thought he was mediocre, and her snobbish family mocked him. His luxury gifts were ruined, his check was called fake, and he was framed, forced to divorce, and jailed. Finally, Adrian exposes his true identity, shames the snobs, and clears the misunderstanding.

items.title: Abandoned Mafia Brides Beneath the Sea
items.intro: Once honored as Black Harbor's Princcesses,Betrayed, Broken, Abandoned. The mermaid sisters return from the depths—not for love, but to seize their true destiny.

items.title: He Saw Her Deadly Fate
items.intro: Adam, a medical student, exposed his supervisor’s falsified research data and was framed for cheating. He was expelled from school and abandoned by his girlfriend.After a car accident, he gained medical x-ray vision, allowing him to see human bones, blood vessels, foreign objects and abnormal lesions inside the body.On his first day after waking up, he discovered an undiagnosed life-threatening condition inside Irene, the female doctor treating him, and saved her life.

items.title: The Token in the Trash
items.intro: Ethan Stone gave all his savings to his family. After his father died, his biased mother gave the house and cash to his siblings, throwing him out with just a broken shoe. He cut ties. The shoe was a twenty-year-old token from a billionaire. Marrying Claire Quinn, Ethan enters a wealthy family, reclaims his empire, and makes a stunning comeback.

items.title: The Dinner That Cost Them Everything
items.intro: Ethan Hayes sold his house to save Elena Lawson's company, but her father stole his dividends and gave houses to other sons-in-law. Ethan quit and withdrew his patents, collapsing the company. He sued the father into jail. Elena repaid him with shares. After restructuring, Ethan left. A year later, they reunite at an airport.

items.title: The Reunion That Made Them Strangers
items.intro: In 2008, Claire Miller is separated from her mother in a crowded train station. Over the years, her mother searches relentlessly, eventually becoming the wealthiest woman in the province. Sixteen years later, Claire finally stands before her. However, her mother fails to recognize her own daughter and brings her unimaginable pain. Frank Miller witnesses this heartbreaking twist of fate.

items.title: The Mountain He Turned into a Fortress
items.intro: Ethan Carter's pig farm is demolished by bullies. His father is crippled, and his fiancée Lily Hart betrays him. He retreats to a barren mountain with an iron gate and supplies. An underground river floods the village due to illegal construction, but his mountain stays safe. Bullies beg outside his gate. Ethan's revenge begins—surveillance and contract traps send them to jail.

items.title: Out of the Storm, Into Her Heart
items.intro: Desperate for his fallen brother's daughter's medical bills, boatman Logan Reed takes a million-dollar job: crossing the deadly sea in three days with heiress Claire Hayes. Claire despises him at first. But when a gang hunts them, Logan uses reefs and storms to fight back. Claire soon realizes he isn't after money, but protecting a debt of honor.

items.title: The Day Their Lies Fell Apart
items.intro: Framed by her adopted sister and betrayed by her family, Clara Foster shocks the nation by becoming the top scorer. Julian Gordon steps in to protect her. At the celebration, the sister's crimes and Julian's identity are exposed. Her family begs for forgiveness, but Clara refuses. She changes her name and starts a new life with Julian.

items.title: Her Death, My Wrath（DUBBED）
items.intro: Damon Frost and Luna Hart, orphaned martial siblings, are inseparable. When Luna returns to her wealthy birth family and is murdered, Damon transforms into a vengeful demon. Carrying her coffin, he storms the engagement banquet, destroys the corrupt tycoon, punishes the fake heiress with worms, and wipes out an ancient evil cult. Revenge is absolute.

items.title: The Wolf’s Bride
items.intro: After being murdered by her jealous sister, Gwendolyn reawakens and chooses to marry the cursed Wolf King—discovering he is a trapped prince—and through kindness earns his loyalty, then refuses to abandon him when her sister and the Queen Mother plot to burn him, as their true love's kiss breaks the curse, exposes the usurpation, and crowns her the rightful queen.

items.title: The Cold Chain That Saved the Village
items.intro: Ethan Wells uses modern cold-chain technology to help farmers. He partners with a poor mountain village, where honest villagers strictly follow scientific breeding. Together, they build the Cloud Mist Black Pig brand and break into the high-end market. This mutual trust and win-win partnership lifts over 10,000 people out of poverty.

items.title: He Was Never Just a Guard
items.intro: Victor Carter, a legendary retired boss, hides his identity as a security guard. His adoptive son forces him to marry a stranger for money. On the wedding day, his first love Claire Morris appears with her daughter, secretly hiding her chairwoman status to test him. Facing humiliation, Victor cuts ties. Soon, his hidden past and her true identity are revealed, triggering a powerful comeback.

items.title: The Legend in the Shadows
items.intro: Ethan Sloan, a legendary ex-soldier and dark lord, is sent to protect cold, silent CEO Celine Blaker. Due to a misunderstanding, she mistakes him for a thug. But as Ethan resolves crisis after crisis, he effortlessly crushes all rival forces and slaps villains in the face. His unmatched strength and charm finally win her over, as he forges a passionate urban legend.

items.title: The Poison She Stole
items.intro: Diane Dawson steals Damian Stone's toxic pufferfish. Despite his frantic warnings, she cooks it, killing her husband. She and her son-in-law then extort Damian. But Damian is secretly the son-in-law's boss. The greedy pair end up in jail.

items.title: Love Grows on the Billionaire’s Farm
items.intro: Min-ah loses everything because of her stepmother and stepsister's scheme. After a rigged lottery, she is forced to leave Seoul and marry Ho-jin, a farmer in a small village. She thinks he is poor, but he is kind and always protects her. Soon, Min-ah discovers his biggest secret. Ho-jin is the billionaire behind Korea's largest agricultural empire! As Min-ah finds love, her greedy stepsister's perfect marriage becomes a nightmare.

items.title: A Million-Dollar Flock of Revenge
items.intro: Ethan Miller returns when his daughter Lily Miller is repeatedly bitten by a neighbor's illegally kept venomous snakes. Pushed out by the biased village chief and villagers, Ethan raises chickens to counter the pests and promises millions to start a business. When the snakes escape and bite many, the illegal farmer and chief face justice. Ethan sets aside the conflict to help both villages develop eco-chicken farming and thrive.

items.title: A Father's Vow That Defied the Heavens
items.intro: Victor Stone, Lord of the Three Realms, hid as a mortal doctor for 20 years. When his daughter was tortured and turned to stone by a prince, he returned to slaughter the prince's family. But the curse was unbreakable. To save her, Victor gives up his throne and powers, becoming mortal to find the flower, which only blooms with tears from ten lifetimes of suffering.

items.title: She Fired Her Own Future
items.intro: Claire Clark and her husband Gavin Stone built an empire but work undercover as cleaners in their own plaza. A social climber becomes the new manager, hoping to marry their son. On day one, she fires and humiliates the couple to help her own parents, unaware they are her future in-laws. After they quit, partners withdraw, the company collapses, and her dream is ruined.

items.title: Melody of Vengeance
items.intro: Ethan Hart, head of a trillion-dollar empire, worked secretly as Ava’s audio engineer. He turned tone-deaf Ava into a top diva, only to be betrayed. At her live concert watched by 50 million, he cut her voice effects. Her real voice ruined her fame, and she owed a $4.2 billion fine. Ethan later met Lily Shen, a gifted singer he helped become a star.

items.title: The Racing King's Runaway Pregnant Wife
items.intro: To pay for her grandmother's surgery, Lucy signs a one-year contract marriage with a stranger. A year later, she joins Lightning Racing—and discovers the playboy ace driver Ethan is her contract husband. After heartbreak, she leaves pregnant; on the podium, he declares to the world: "Wherever you go, I will find you."

items.title: Eclipse Covenant
items.intro: Ivy sacrificed her true name and seven years of Moonfire to save Noah. But at his ascension feast, he tore up their betrothal, allied with Lady Eve, and stripped Ivy of her Moonfire and beast-soul, leaving her for dead.Ronan, Blackwood’s lethal ruler, found her in the rain and saw the royal truth she’d hidden. He offered her a bargain: revenge.Under his protection, Ivy reforges her bloodline and hunts the conspiracy......

items.title: Bloodmoon Hunter: Silver-Dawn's Revenge
items.intro: Young Lucian witnesses his mother's sacrifice to stop the vampire regent Cassian Voss. Fifteen years later, Lucian becomes a demon hunter, joins forces with Evelyn, and uncovers Voss's plot to use his sun bloodline to activate the blood anchor. After trials and sacrifices, Lucian defeats Voss.

items.title: The Devil Only Wants Her
items.intro: Lily Clark travels to Sterling City to get money for her sick grandmother’s surgery. On the train, she meets feared crime boss Alexander Vance, who falls for her after she tends his wounds. Forced into a marriage to save her grandma, Lily initially mistakes another man for her childhood savior. Gradually, she discovers Alexander is the boy who once rescued her. After fighting family plots and dangerous conflicts, the pair overcome hardships and embrace their true love......

items.title: Mother of Dragons Awakens: I Divorced the Dragonslayer
items.intro: After six years of neglect and humiliation, Celia ends the Sacred Marriage Pact and walks away. She discovers she carries the bloodline of the Mother of All Dragons. With Dragon Lord Sebastian, she claims the Origin Crystal, awakens her power, and destroys the corruption. She leaves Henry and starts anew.

items.title: My Hearing Beat the Odds
items.intro: Hospital janitor Rick has a car accident and awakens the ability to hear all living things. He exposes his fiancée's betrayal, fights to save his brother, and is dragged into elite power struggles, gang feuds, and sea crises. He rises from the bottom to become a hero.

items.title: Prophecy's Divine Child
items.intro: Crown Princess Isolde bears a child out of wedlock and endures six years of shame. She returns to the capital with her son Lane, facing her father's scorn, her sister's schemes, and her fiancé's humiliation. Kaelan, Emperor of Oren, follows the oracle to seek her hand and shield them.

items.title: The Swapped Bride Never Looks Back
items.intro: On the eve of her wedding, a woman is repeatedly misjudged and hurt by her fiancé due to her sister's lies—so she lets go, swaps brides with her sister, and willingly marries the legendary bloodthirsty half-beast. When the truth is revealed and her regretful ex rides to take her back, she has already found true love in the beast's keep—shielding the half-beast with her own body, breaking the curse through true love, and marrying the prince restored to human form.

items.title: The Empress Returns: Dragon's Wrath
items.intro: Dragon Empress Vesera is betrayed and killed by her fiancé, the hidden Abyss Lord, on their wedding day. She shatters her body into relics and vows bloody revenge. Reborn, she returns to reclaim her throne and make every traitor pay.

items.title: Taste Prison
items.intro: To find her sister, who vanished two years ago, talented young chef Ivy Sterling goes undercover aboard ""Le Néant"", a luxury cruise ship sailing across the Mediterranean. There, she meets Lucian, a ruthless head chef who may be connected to her sister's disappearance. But the more she investigates, the harder it becomes to resist him.Ivy soon discovers that Lucian's mysterious dishes are based on a secret technique developed by her sister.

items.title: The Arcane Pact: Bound to MyStepbrother Professor
items.intro: Half-blood Cecilia enters Royal Academy and is bullied by pure-blood Eve’s group. She meets powerful mage Lok, whose painful soul burn only her magic can calm. He binds her with a soul pact. Living together at school, they grow close while Cecilia’s secret identity slowly unfolds.

items.title: The Fate The Only
items.intro: Half-orc half-elf Delixis, scorned by her royal father, hides her mighty magic. After betrayal and loss, she rebuilds her power, resurrects her adoptive mother Perses, raises a rebel army, defeats the orc king and her tyrant father, and is crowned empress to unite all races.

items.title: The Last Dragon's Ashes
items.intro: Knight Arthur is framed and sent to a death mine. His blood awakens the black dragon Valez. He leads a rebellion, exposes the Queen's usurpation, and defeats the demon Baal. He refuses honors and guards the dragon tomb, where a new dragon egg cracks.

items.title: Don't Kiss the Coroner
items.intro: Eighteen years after her family’s massacre, Mara joins Chicago Forensic Center. She uncovers her father Victor, a Hollow mastermind, betrayed her kin. Gifted with death visions, she navigates suspicion and prophecy: she must stab immortal Elias to stop Victor, then saves him, stripping his immortality.

items.title: The Cursed Student：Sovereign of Star-Dome
items.intro: Star Sovereign Emilio de León, caught in a dimensional storm, possesses Lex, a dying boy with Star Decay. His sister Valentina enters the academy for a star crystal and is humiliated; Lex secretly guides her to break through and reveals Astral Summoning, earning a tournament place. He defeats Planet Devourer Morgan but damages his foundation. Morgan’s remnant leader Fallon kidnaps Valentina; she shields Lex, awakening his full Sovereign power.

items.title: Dragon Daughter Fell From The Sky
items.intro: Vincent, the Godfather of the Mafia, is afflicted with a curse that will take his life at thethe age of 30. He travels to the forest in search of power to break it, when a three-year-old dragon child, Lia, suddenly falls from the sky. Lia recognizes Vincent as her father. With dragon powers such as breathing fire and superhuman strength, she repeatedly saves him from mortal danger, and can also suppress and heal the curse.

items.title: The Black Panther Prince's Secret Wife
items.intro: On the Beastman Continent, the panther clan held hegemony, while the rabbit clan was regarded as lowly. Aurora, a rabbit clan girl, was saved by Talon, the Panther King, and the two developed feelings for each other. Clover, a panther woman who loved Talon, grew jealous. She set a trap involving a gargoyle attack and falsely claimed that Aurora was a doom-bringer destined to destroy the panther clan. Talon readily believed the slander and, in a rage, exiled Aurora.

items.title: The Heiress They Threw Away
items.intro: Tessa Stone, a real heiress, is framed by the fake heiress and thrown out. Penniless, she asks seven young men, including Logan Hart, to be her adoptive fathers so she can study. They support her; she scores 689 and enters a top university. She refuses to return and starts a business with them, growing from a restaurant into a clothing brand. The fake heiress plots, but they expose her and bring her to justice. They become a happy family without blood ties.

items.title: The Wedding Where the Truth Walked In
items.intro: Stella Stone receives shares from her father at graduation. Her jealous future sister-in-law frames her, but Adrian Blake saves her. The sister-in-law, with Stella's cousin, hires a fake mother and forges a DNA test to turn Stella's brother against the family. He marries the enemy. Stella stays calm, gathers evidence with Adrian, and exposes the truth at the wedding. Her brother regrets it, Stella reclaims the company, and finds happiness."

items.title: The Kindness That Built an Empire
items.intro: Thirty years ago, Gavin Brooks saved orphan Claire Carter and funded her education. He later lost everything in a business war—bankrupt, disabled, and abandoned. Now a billionaire, Claire returns to find him. She fights his ex-wife’s cruelty, thugs, and project traps with sharp business tactics. Gavin awakens his technical genius. Together they crush the old conspiracy and rebuild a billion-dollar empire.

items.title: The Wife Who Rewrote Her Ending
items.intro: In her past life, Claire Turner gave up her career for family, but her husband Adrian Foster only loved another woman, and even their children preferred her. When he succeeded, he abandoned Claire. Reborn, she refuses to endure it again. She becomes a TV host and vows to live for herself.

items.title: Check-in to the Queen
items.intro: A historical rom-com fantasy about a future Queen who wakes up overnight as a modern-day Airbnb host. Now, she must adapt to the 21st century while trying to deduce which of her three flower-boy guests was the one she spent the night with!

items.title: A Con Man? Or the Billionaire's Savior?
items.intro: Park Do-jin works at a car wash with one secret: he is the grandson of Korea's greatest geomancer. To save his dying mother, he breaks his family's taboo and takes to the streets, where he sees through the fate of a chaebol family's dying child. "We have to dig up the ancestral grave before sunset today." Everyone laughs at him as a scammer—until the grave is opened and a century-old curse and dark magic come to light.

items.title: The Greatest Mage
items.intro: During a demon-spirit attack, Will displays ancient star power and saves the villagers. At the academy, he is harassed by noble-born Lucas and his father Kazzafi. In the World Tree Trial, he is framed—but when the demon god Barbatos invades, Will fuses the World Tree's remnants with the Supreme God's blessing and seals the demon god forever.

items.title: She Was Never Just a Pretty Face（DUBBED）
items.intro: Claire Vaughn is seen as Ethan Grant's kept woman, spending on bags. In truth, she is the highest regulator of global finance. When twelve overseas capitals hunt his family, his father resigns and brothers are jailed. Ethan surrenders his shares to protect her. Then Claire reactivates her authority, freezes global trading with one call, forces the twelve to compensate, and exposes the plot to frame and kidnap his brothers.

items.title: Eight Dogs and a Hidden Fortune
items.intro: Logan Harris cared for his sick grandfather for three years, but inherited only a run-down dog kennel and eight old dogs. His uncles took the house, antique shop, and savings. His wife Claire Mason wanted a divorce. Then his grandfather appeared in a dream. The dogs led Logan to a stone trough—inside were gold, jade, Song porcelain, Ming paintings, and relics. His uncles soon came to grab the treasure. Can he protect it?

items.title: After the Sacrifice, Pregnant by the Sea God
items.intro: In drought-stricken Arathia, Lyra is sold as a sacrifice. She escapes by leaping off a cliff, saves the poisoned sea god Kaelon, and becomes pregnant. When recaptured for the ritual, Kaelon recognizes her at the altar.

items.title: Wrath of Winter
items.intro: Betrayed by his lieutenant and cast into the Abyss, Archmage Darius returns three years later stronger than ever. He finds his sister being tortured and his empire stolen. Furious, he exposes the traitor, retakes his three magical legions, and begins a brutal revenge to reclaim everything that was taken from him.

items.title: Pregnant by My Ex's Father
items.intro: Elara, a delivery girl, stumbles into the room of feared mafia don Silas and ends up carrying his child—only to discover her cheating "boyfriend" Jackson is actually Silas's son, turning father and son against each other. After Silas strips Jackson of his name, power, and place in the family at the assembly, the man who once made her tremble drops to one knee and offers her a ring: "Marry me—let me protect you for the rest of your life."

items.title: THE THREE LORDS THIRSTY FOR HER
items.intro: Alice becomes a wet nurse at Silver Moon Manor. She calms the eldest son Leo’s mania, wins the third son Edward’s attachment, and attracts the second son Lucas—who proposes in the nursery closet. As passion rises, Leo follows the familiar scent of milk to the door. The forbidden tangle is about to explode.

items.title: The Sea Devil‘s Substitute Bride
items.intro: Before her marking ceremony, the female lead discovers Alpha Leon only pretended to love her to win the Alpha King election—so in a drunken fury, she spends a night with a stranger, then swaps grooms with her stepsister to marry the rumored "Sea Demon" Alaric, hoping to use his power to become the next female Alpha King. But the handsome stranger who took her first time turns out to be the Sea Demon himself—and a new life is already growing inside her.

items.title: When Honor Is Written in Blood
items.intro: After fallen hero Connor is killed in action, his wife Elena and daughter Sarah are denied his death benefits and crushed by debt. Sarah travels to a military base with her father's Medal of Honor and meets his former comrade Benjamin. He vows to protect them—and discovers the $500,000 survivor benefits have mysteriously vanished.

items.title: Reborn from the Ashes: The Betrayed Princess and Her Dragon Lord
items.intro: Irina, princess of Aeris and heir to the Dragonbinder pact, gave everything to the commoner Roland—only to be sacrificed by him and his lover Celeste to the Dark Dragon Lord. Saved by Alaric, the Dark Dragon Lord she once dismissed as a lovesick fool, she is sent back three years to awaken as the queen chosen by him.

items.title: Super-firefighter
items.intro: Impoverished firefighter Zane gains superpowers, including pyrokinesis, x-ray vision, teleportation, after an electric shock. He becomes CEO Veronica Winters' contract fiancé, foils C4 bombings and dark web assassins, crushes villain Cassius Slater, and terrifies his estranged dark-corporate father Cole Slater so badly that Cole mistakes him for a “national-level secret boss”and all while Zane rises to the top with his sweet wife by his side.

items.title: The Wolfless Heir is the Lycan King
items.intro: After 20 years missing, wolfless heir Ethan Hart returns to a powerful werewolf family that scorns him. Hidden by a bloodstone ring, he is really the Lycan King. He heals his three cursed sisters, exposes adoptive heir Adrian’s betrayals, reclaims Hart Group, and confronts his fated mate Sophie—while enemies try to destroy the pack.

items.title: The Woman You Humiliated Is the Tycoon's Mom
items.intro: Grace Carter takes the train alone to her son Alex's engagement party, hiding her pacemaker scar and the fact that Alex runs the Carter Group. Her future daughter-in-law Vic and the Hayes family take her for a pauper and humiliate her in public - until the Carter crest on a helicopter shows exactly who they have been trampling on.

items.title: Beast Academy: Taming My Vampire Professor
items.intro: Erin Carter is the only human ever admitted to Beast Academy, a school ruled by shifters and pureblood vampires. On day one, cold Professor Lucius Ashton throws her out, then secretly shields her. When werewolf heir Arthur claims she is his fated mate, a deadly rivalry erupts. Between bites and betrayals, Erin must tame the devil who owns her soul.

items.title: That Chosen One Can't Be Me
items.intro: Logan, raised by Zach on a backwater world, dreams of being a Star Knight despite testing powerless. When pirates attack, he erupts with godlike power, then loses it. He seeks Grand Master Han's training, awakens an ancient Starblade, and at the Trials shatters every record of the sacred Ninefold—revealing he's the Chosen One, Han's long-lost son stolen by the Order's corrupt leader. Reunited with family, Logan defeats the traitor and becomes the Star Knights' new leader.

items.title: My Unhatched Egg Chose the Phoenix Lord Daddy at My Wedding
items.intro: This romantic fantasy follows Elara Ash, whose wedding to Rowan Crow is interrupted by her unborn son Milo in a golden egg, revealing his real father is Phoenix Lord Cassian. Rowan and Elara's sister Cora drugged Elara three months prior to blackmail Cassian with the heir.

items.title: Under The Hood, I’m The Legend Racer
items.intro: Legendary driver Kai is framed, his brother killed in a rigged crash, and he is banned for life. Hiding as a mechanic and rideshare driver for three years, he crushes supercars in a beat-up taxi, exposing his true identity and drawing a final duel with his rival Maddox.

items.title: Don't Mess with the Reaper
items.intro: Delta Force commander Jack retires to protect his family but finds them terrorized by a biker gang. He teams up with DHS agent Elena and old comrades to dismantle the corrupt criminal network behind it.

items.title: Mommy I Found My Dragon King Daddy
items.intro: To save the Dragon King she loves, Isla sacrifices her powers and memories, awakening as a lowly rabbit shifter. Five years later, her little dragon son befriends a mysterious master, unaware he is his father. As royal rivals threaten their lives, lost memories and a hidden phoenix bloodline may reunite a family destined to rule.

items.title: Fake Dating My Crush's Brother for Real
items.intro: Julian has loved student council president Arthur for years, sure Arthur is the anonymous sponsor paying his tuition. At a party he hands his confession letter over - but gives it to the wrong brother. Silas, fresh from catching his girlfriend cheating, claims the letter as his own and announces they are dating. The fake romance slowly turns real.

items.title: Eight Years Unclaimed, Then I Left the Alpha
items.intro: Eight years ago, low-ranked healer Maya Reed served her mate, son, and Blackrock Pack—yet was never legally recognized as Luna. When Damon’s “dead” first love returns, mate, son, in-laws, and pack betray her. Maya flees, withdraws every hidden sacrifice, exposes the fake death and power plot, and makes each abuser pay.

items.title: My Burger-Flipping Dad Is the Godfather
items.intro: For 18 years, Arthur Blackwood has hidden his identity as the legendary Godfather, trading his criminal empire for a quiet life raising his daughter, Chloe. But when a ruthless mafia heir destroys her life, Arthur's dark past comes roaring back. As Chloe fights to reclaim her strength, father and daughter uncover a conspiracy behind her mother's murder—and prepare to take down the powerful organization responsible. This time, the Godfather has nothing left to lose.

items.title: They Kicked Me Out, Then the Company Collapsed
items.intro: Ethan spent eight years at Grayson—saved it three times. Before IPO, the boss's protégée gave herself $500K, her cousin $80K, and Ethan—$3K.He warned: wire $10M by 3PM. They told him to get out.So he left. At 3:00, the bank pulled $50M. Grayson collapsed.Now they beg. He answers: "Didn't you say Grayson could go public without me?"He buys abandoned line and steals their top contract. Eight years loyal dog—this time, he came to collect.

items.title: I Bathed a Cat. He Was the Archmage
items.intro: Cast out by her father, six-year-old Vivian survives in the woods where monsters obey her gentle magic. Twelve years later she enters Windermere Academy to learn how her mother died, and collides with Wentworth, the cold Archmage every student fears. The girl who tamed hellhounds may be the only one who can tame him.

items.title: Snow Mountain Betrayal: Left to Freeze, Saved by a Billionaire
items.intro: Betrayed and left to die in an Alaskan blizzard, climate researcher Ivy Whitfield loses both her life's work and her future. When billionaire Dante Crane rescues her, Ivy returns to expose the thieves, reclaim her name, and face a new battle for love and acceptance within the powerful Crane family.

items.title: The Curvy Queen & Her Alpha Billionaires
items.intro: Humiliated in public by her ex-boyfriend and a snobbish heiress, plus-size Maya is drowning in debt. Then she binds with the "Absolute Soothing System" and suddenly becomes the only cure for a vampire progenitor, an Alpha werewolf, a siren CEO, and a dragon. One touch and these monster tycoons drop to their knees and throw penthouses at her feet. All she wants is to pay off her loans and wear a wedding dress of her own design. But the tycoons? They are going to war over her.

items.title: The Elf Prince's Mute Mommy
items.intro: Human girl Selena is framed by Elf Queen Walda, causing her to lose her memory and voice. She is sent to the hunter Edmund, who torments her for three years. Elf Prince Lucian searches for his mother after seeing her in his dreams and meets Selena in the forest. When wolves attack, Selena risks her life to protect him, and mother and son recognize each other by the matching flower-shaped birthmarks on their collarbones.

items.title: The Dragon Prince's Substitute Bride
items.intro: She sealed her voice for twelve years to save him. He bared his fangs and scales to protect her. When she finally speaks, even the gods become her weapon.

items.title: Too Late to Want Me Back
items.intro: Elaine supports her husband Jason for five years as he becomes a tech tycoon. She discovers his "incapacitation" after a car accident was a lie—he has been cheating with Chloe and secretly transferring their joint assets. Elaine divorces him, reclaims her true heiress status, and methodically settles scores with Jason and Chloe.

items.title: Forbidden Touch
items.intro: Postpartum and in pain, Clara's husband calls her messy. Her stepson Ethan gets dangerously close. A blackout nearly exposes their secret. For eight years, her husband bought lingerie for another woman. Betrayed, will she stay or fall for Ethan?

items.title: The Men Beneath the Throne
items.intro: Dragon tamer Daisy is framed by her fiancé. She awakens the golden dragon Jin and an ancient fire-immune bloodline. In the palace, she falls for cursed Prince Arthur, foils conspiracies, and rises from orphan to Dragon Mother and Queen.

items.title: Twin Blessings: My Children's Father Is the Elf King
items.intro: Elf King Silas loves human Aria, but his mother Morwen forces Aria to drink a blinding poison and fakes her death. Seven years later, Silas meets Aria and their twin daughters but doesn't recognize them. After conspiracies and kidnappings, the family reunites; Morwen heals Aria's eyes.

items.title: My boss is a cat？！
items.intro: Designer Katherine, bullied by her boss Sebastian and framed by her colleague Beatrice, angrily wishes that the arrogant CEO would turn into a black cat every night—and on a rainy night, she unknowingly takes the helpless cat home to her shabby apartment. As Sebastian witnesses her kindness and burdens by day as her boss and by night as her cat, he secretly clears her name while hiding his secret—until Katherine's whole-hearted acceptance breaks the curse, and they find love.

items.title: His Rejected Mate Was the Wolf Princess
items.intro: A lowly Omega sacrifices everything for her Alpha husband, only to be betrayed and bullied. When her sealed royal pureblood bloodline awakens, she rises to become a royal empress. Her scumbag husband is drugged and deceived; after learning the truth, he goes to extremes to chase her—but his belated affection is useless.

items.title: They Took Me In, I Made Them Proud
items.intro: Mia Carter, a real heiress, is framed by a fake daughter and kicked out. Hungry and fainting, she is taken in by six dyed-hair young men led by Luke Hayes. They save every bite to fund her studies. She scores 689 and enters a top university. At the banquet, framed again, she uses surveillance and her admission letter to slap the fake heiress. With her million-yuan compensation, she opens a restaurant for her six adoptive fathers. They become a real family.

items.title: She Saves His Empire, Then Goes Shopping
items.intro: Claire Walsh seems like Adrian Carter's spoiled shopper, swiping his black card on bags. Actually, she's a retired financial risk expert. When his firm faces a hostile short-sell, frozen funds, and leaks, she stops hiding. With key evidence, she helps Adrian find the traitor and defuse the crisis. The plot is exposed, the guilty are punished, and the firm is reborn. Claire returns to swiping his card, living freely.

items.title: The Unborn Who Rewrote Her Fate
items.intro: In 1920s,poor student Claire Walsh spends a night with young marshal Ethan Foster. Pregnant, she hears her unborn daughter's voice—warning of their past death. Reborn, she moves into his villa, transforms, and with her baby's help, exposes her best friend and his first love's schemes. After a cliff fall, she's saved, cleared, and marries Ethan, becoming his beloved wife.

items.title: Daddy, Will You Take Me Home?
items.intro: Nora Stone finds a missing-person flyer by a trash bin on New Year's Eve. The girl in the photo matches her, including the maple-leaf birthmark. She uses her saved coin to call. Adrian Stone arrives through the snow. DNA confirms she is his daughter. She gains a family, friends, and a room with a nightlight. Real home is learning to trust—someone will always wait for her and hold her hand.

items.title: The Roommate Who Stole My Life
items.intro: Logan Carter hides his wealth in a college dorm. His roommate steals his supercar key and club card, poses as a rich heir, and takes his girlfriend. Logan lets him show off. At the club, the card freezes and the car locks. Logan arrives with his sister and Vivian Hayes, exposes the truth, and the fake heir is humiliated. He stops hiding and strikes back.

items.title: He Faked Death, She Built a Life
items.intro: Claire Parker raised her twin sons alone for 18 years after her husband Victor Stone faked his death with his mistress. At their college celebration, Victor and his mistress return, demanding divorce and custody. Claire agrees—and hands them a gift she prepared 18 years ago.

items.title: From Wasteland to Wealth
items.intro: Betrayed by his partner and wife, Ethan Hayes inherits an abandoned reef. A mysterious old man teaches him a secret fish-luring skill. He makes a quick fortune, sells the useless reef at a high price, and moves to deep-sea fishing. Against a rich rival's sonar fleet, he beats modern tech with old tricks and catches a full haul of bluefin tuna. An underdog's rise.

items.title: From Ruined Delivery to Redemption
items.intro: Derek Stone saves a pregnant woman in a storm. Fired for being late and forced to divorce by his in-laws, he's cleared when the woman's CEO husband finds him. He refuses a reward, starts a home care center, wins back Emma Reed, and gets investment. Good deeds pay off.

items.title: She Was Never Just a Pretty Face
items.intro: Claire Vaughn is seen as Ethan Grant's kept woman, spending on bags. In truth, she is the highest regulator of global finance. When twelve overseas capitals hunt his family, his father resigns and brothers are jailed. Ethan surrenders his shares to protect her. Then Claire reactivates her authority, freezes global trading with one call, forces the twelve to compensate, and exposes the plot to frame and kidnap his brothers.

items.title: Playing Dumb to Take Them All Down
items.intro: Ethan Carter is a master of medicine and martial arts. To uncover the truth of his childhood disappearance, he disguises himself as a fool and returns home. His three sisters dote on him. A fake heir, a scheming fiancé, and a rival sect plot against him. He plays dumb while striking in secret. When his heir token is revealed, everyone is stunned—the fool they mocked silences them all.

items.title: My Foolish Husband Is an Immortal
items.intro: Adrian Vale, a centuries-old immortal healer, hides his power and plays the fool to marry Claire Stone. Her family protects him for three years. When enemies frame and poison them, he drops the act. Using his skills, he strikes back and is revealed as a legend. But his real treasure is their love.

items.title: Reborn to Build My Own Empire
items.intro: Evan Grant won 5 million in a lottery and faked being a rich heir to join high society. Ten years later, he was exposed and humiliated. He wakes up in his senior year of high school, reborn. With the same 5 million, he starts over—timber deals, rubber futures, crude oil. This time, he vows to be a true self-made founder. Along the way, Mia Allen is by his side.

items.title: The Gift That Was a Trap
items.intro: At the birthday banquet, the mother-in-law gives Erin Baker's daughter a heavy gift box. Everyone thinks it's money, but Erin refuses it and cuts ties. Inside: IOUs and loan contracts. The mother-in-law planned to make Erin and her daughter pay. Her husband Evan Ward forces her. Erin divorces him, calls police, and exposes the truth. She and her daughter leave the toxic family.

items.title: Daddy, Don’t Go, Please Save Mommy
items.intro: Ten years after Graciela disappeared to save her wealthy husband's life, their daughter Ema struggles to raise $300,000 for her mother's life-saving treatment. A chance encounter with billionaire Adrian Linares reveals he's Ema's father and Graciela is his long-lost wife. As Adrian fights to reunite his family, a jealous fiancée, a sinister conspiracy, and shocking secrets threaten to destroy everything.

items.title: The Bowl That Made Her Rich
items.intro: After serving her grandmother for ten years, Claire Carter gets only a broken bowl and is kicked out. She discovers her grandmother came from forty years in the future, and her diary predicts the market. Using the bowl for capital, she bets on stocks and real estate, rising to business legend. But her grandmother's real gift was a fearless heart.

items.title: The Lake Remembers What They Did
items.intro: Claire Reed guarded a giant serpent for years, keeping her village safe. Her son Evan Reed and his wife found gold and forced her to drive it away. She refused; they went anyway. She tried to stop them but was beaten. They angered the serpent, which attacked. Claire calmed it and made them vow not to touch the gold. But they broke their vow and poisoned the serpent. Heartbroken, Claire left with it. Without it, bandits enslaved the village.

items.title: When the Nanny Took Off Her Apron
items.intro: Helen Stone, a nanny, steps up when Ryan Hale's company is attacked. Mocked by all, no one knows her three sons are powerful tycoons. Instead of using their money, she uses wisdom, exposing a rival company and a traitor. With recordings and contracts, she saves the family. After repaying 20 years of kindness, she quits and moves to Hainan to live for herself.

items.title: Exiled to the Barren North, I Grow an Empire
items.intro: Ecologist Evelyn Rowan transmigrates as a banished noble's daughter in the Northern Desert. With botanical knowledge and plant powers, she carves oases, battles corrupt officials, builds firearms, and turns the desert into a thriving cross-border trade center while finding true love.

items.title: You Picked the Wrong Heiress
items.intro: Scholarship student Sloane is secretly crime boss Marcus's illegitimate daughter. To save her mother, she enters the underworld, seizes the casino, faces the Thirteen Slashes, and manipulates three families—while helping police bring them down.

items.title: Switched at Birth: Backed by Her Own Tribe
items.intro: Evelyn Carter was switched at birth and spent forty years away from her real family. Reunited with the powerful Bennett clan, she faces harassment from Chloe and coldness from her birth mother. With her husband and children, she exposes Chloe's identity theft and builds a foundation for separated families.

items.title: My Family Chose Her, But I'll Take Back Everything
items.intro: Sarah Whitmore gave everything to the people she loved, only to be betrayed by her fiancé, her best friend, and her own family. After losing her unborn child and everything she had worked for, she finally walks away from them all. Backed by the powerful billionaire Alexander Sterling, Sarah launches a ruthless comeback—determined to reclaim her fortune, make every one of them regret what they did to her, and watch their world fall apart.

items.title: Drowning Love
items.intro: Elvis, a CEO suffering from severe insomnia amid a US conglomerate power struggle, disguises himself as a part-time swim coach to get close to Amber, a broke, pale college student who lost his memory to PTSD after saving Elvis by firing a gun at twelve. With a wealthy childhood friend constantly stirring things up and the charged push-and-pull in the pool, the two complete a fated mutual redemption.

items.title: Pregnant by the War God: His Maid Wife
items.intro: Daphne, a daughter of the gods, is reduced to a maid. She becomes pregnant with War God Ares's twins. Framed by her foster mother, she and Ares face painful misunderstandings. As her divine bloodline awakens, she rises above betrayal and marries Ares before all the gods.

items.title: Reborn to Let Him Have Her（DUBBED）
items.intro: When her husband Adrian Voss demands a second child with his ex Paige Moore — unaware Paige has HIV — Vivian Carter refuses. A year later, Paige and the child die, and Adrian pushes Vivian's family off a cliff, blaming her. Reborn to that same day, Vivian smiles: "Go ahead. My family fully supports you."

items.title: My Flash-Marriage Husband is the EIf King
items.intro: To save her dying mother, half-elf Lina agrees to a convenient marriage with a penniless guard—never knowing he is Kaelen, the disguised Elf Prince. Amid royal prejudice and jealous rivals, they fall in love, while Kaelen nearly blows his cover. When her sealed memories return, she learns a forgotten night five years ago left her carrying his child. Facing class divide and royal foes, they bring their child home, uncover the truth, and find their happily ever after.

items.title: They Killed the Fat Dragon—She Returned for the Throne
items.intro: A dragon princess who grew fat on purpose to live in peace is murdered on her wedding day by her fiancé Kano and her cousin Leia. Saved by Torin, the true Dragon King, she trains five years and returns to take the throne—proving through bloodline trials and a dark dragon war that a queen needs neither love nor noble blood, only her own strength.

items.title: The Prince's Mistress Mocked Me—But I'm the Dragon Queen
items.intro: Everyone takes Seraphina for a gossip-loving Dragon Queen, so when Prince Cassian's mistress Lyra humiliates her and frames her for a crime, she lets them gloat. Piece by piece she exposes Lyra's fake pregnancy and forged letters, strips Cassian of his succession and sets her own son on the throne—then rides off to enjoy the next scandal.

items.title: My Pet Dragon Turned Out to Be My Fated King!
items.intro: After her husband dumps her for gaining weight and her son is ashamed to call her Mom, Zoe buys a palm-sized companion dragon—the one creature guaranteed to love her. She names him Mochi, cuddles him, and rubs his crystal horns every night. Five weeks later, the pet store calls: they sent the wrong dragon. Mochi is Christian, the ancient Dragon King—and touching his horns means far more than Zoe ever imagined.

items.title: Love Square: No One Is Innocent
items.intro: A rafting trip tangles four lives: orphan Grace, married to a 45-year-old influencer; his son Leo, who wants his stepmother; and Lisa, who wants Grace. Each holds a secret worth exposing, so instead of tearing each other apart they sign a truce and move under one roof, where mutual blackmail turns into mutual obsession and nobody is innocent.

items.title: Billionaire Leopard Dad, You Owe Me a Family
items.intro: A five-year-old snow leopard arrives at a billionaire's mansion with one letter. Her mother is dead. She goes to find her father—a cold billionaire who doesn't believe she exists. His girlfriend does everything to keep her out. What really happened to her mother—and what secret is sealed inside that letter?

items.title: Leech, Pay Your Own Bill
items.intro: Sienna is the founder of Harrison Group. Her family thinks she's just an employee. Her half-sister Chloe takes credit for every bill Sienna pays. When the family visits New York, Chloe orders an $86,000 dinner—and expects Sienna to pay. This time, Sienna refuses.

items.title: He Chose My Sister, I Chose My New Life as Heiress
items.intro: At the altar, Lena refuses to marry Nathan and reveals the truth: while she faked amnesia, her fiancé and adoptive sister exposed their three-year affair—and her family helped cover it up. They think she is a helpless orphan with nowhere else to go. Then billionaire CEO Alex Hawthorne walks in with roses. Lena is not abandoned; she is the sole heir to the city's richest family, and this wedding is about to become their reckoning.

items.title: Dumb Pup No More : Seven Alpha Brothers Beg Me to Carry the Day
items.intro: Lena Wood, once mocked as a powerless wolf pup, hides the strength and wisdom of an ancient Alpha. When her family is threatened by a ruthless wolf clan alliance, she reveals her true abilities and turns the tables on her enemies. With seven protective Alpha brothers by her side, Lena proves that the weakest-looking wolf can become the most terrifying force.

items.title: Disguised Alpha Queen Dumps Fiancé for His Brother
items.intro: Alpha Queen Selena disguises herself as a plain wolf with no spirit to find her destined mate, only to catch her fiance Ryan cheating with Isabella. She finds an unexpected resonance with Ryan's brother Kane, endures humiliation while hiding her power, and rises to expose every enemy and claim her throne and her true love.

items.title: Hidden Alpha Queen: A Mother's Fury
items.intro: Ten years after sealing her legendary wolf power and her infant son's royal blood to survive the massacre of Silvercrest, Sora lives as a powerless omega mother in Blackridge—until her son is framed and targeted by the pack, forcing the hidden White Alpha Queen to fight through a brutal Mother's Challenge while risking the secret identity that could bring an entire kingdom to its knees.

items.title: Dead Girl Logging In: The Revenge Roulette
items.intro: After her best friend Evelyn is bullied to death, Nora watches Evelyn's dead account return with a WISH WHEEL link. The class spins and gets what it wants—offers, jackpots, beauty, a healed mother. Nora suspects a trap and becomes their target. When all 46 wishes are claimed, the wheel demands repayment; Evelyn's evidence is released and every bully pays with interest. Nora walks away, carrying Evelyn's last words: don't forgive them for me, don't stay where I had to leave.

items.title: On Fire For My Bestie's Dad
items.intro: When Cora's home is torched over her boyfriend's dangerous debt, a commanding stranger rescues her and offers the protection she has never known. Their instant attraction ignites—until she discovers her silver-fox savior, firefighter captain Jackson, is her best friend's father. Caught between loyalty, danger, and forbidden desire, Cora must decide whether some fires are worth surrendering to.

items.title: Carrying My Ex's Dad's Heir, I Became His Stepmother
items.intro: Gwen returns to the Sterling family four months pregnant after her billionaire husband's death, only to be mocked by her ex and his brother. When Pierce Sterling's will reveals she and her unborn child are the sole heirs, Gwen exposes the truth, takes control of the empire, and makes everyone who betrayed her pay.

items.title: His Ghost Wife
items.intro: After dying to save Vincent, Connie remains by his side as a ghost for four years—until he cruelly drives her away for another woman. Only after her spirit fades does she learn the truth: Vincent never stopped loving her and sacrificed years of his life to keep her soul from disappearing. Given a second chance in a new body, Connie returns to him, uncovers the secret behind her death, and fights for the love fate tried to steal.

items.title: My Sweet Husband Is the Manhattan Butcher
items.intro: Amnesiac Aiden is the meek stray Chloe keeps as a servant, until debt collectors corner him and he kills all three bare-handed. She realizes her obedient dog is the Manhattan Butcher, heir to the Cole empire. Terrified yet addicted to his devotion, Chloe learns to stand beside a monster, and the man who ends lives for her will kneel only to her.

items.title: Awakening: Poseidon's Heir
items.intro: Abandoned as a freak at birth, mermaid princess Sierra awakens the Power of Poseidon and returns to the royal city. With overwhelming power, she crushes her treacherous father and the fake princess who stole her destiny, shatters the old bloodline hierarchy, and rises as the true ruler of the deep.

items.title: They Left Me to Die on Thanksgiving
items.intro: On Thanksgiving, Mia struggles to breathe—but her twin sister, family, and even her ER-doctor fiancé turn their backs on her. After years of being overlooked and betrayed, Mia finally walks away from the people who never valued her. She rebuilds her career, reclaims her independence, and discovers a life beyond their control. Now her ex is desperate for a second chance. But can he win back the woman he abandoned—or has he lost her for good?

items.title: I Fell into a Werewolf Novel—and Won Everyone Over!
items.intro: Top veterinarian Cecilia dies and wakes inside a werewolf novel, able to understand animal speech. To save the ailing little princess Sia, she clashes with the icy Wolf King Lucas and a scheming royal healer. With evidence and kindness she unmasks a conspiracy and wins the pack's trust, then chooses Lucas and a family of her own.

items.title: The Heiress Always Wins
items.intro: The night before her wedding, Eve catches her fiancé marrying her best friend over a bet! Humiliated and betrayed, she challenges them to one final gamble—with everything they own on the line. They think she's a broke nobody. What they don't know? She's the secret heiress of the casino they're standing in. And tonight, she's taking EVERYTHING.

items.title: My Fool Fiancé The Ultimate Dragon Knight
items.intro: Leia's fiancé Aiden is mocked as a useless fool with no dragon blood. No one knows he is the legendary first Dragon Rider bonded with Aurelion, the divine dragon. When frost giants tear the capital apart and noble Darius schemes to claim Leia, Aiden calls the dragon forth, shattering every insult.

items.title: Your Fake-CEO Boyfriend Begging Me on His Knees
items.intro: After four years away, billionaire Vivian Shaw returns to find her boyfriend posing as the chairman of her empire while spoiling his mistress. He treats Vivian like a nobody, never realizing she owns it all. But betrayal has its price. The real chairwoman is back—and the man who stole her power and broke her heart will soon beg for mercy.

items.title: My baby daddy is the blood of all father
items.intro: They mocked him as a worthless commoner. Little did they know, Kaelen carries the blood of the All-Father. Hiding his godlike powers, he lives as an ordinary man, until his enemies dare to harm his wife and daughter. Now, the man they once humiliated is ready to unleash his wrath. But as his true identity begins to surface, a far greater secret threatens to shake the kingdom. What happens when the heir to the All-Father's power finally stops holding back?

items.title: Married to a Peasant？He Commands Dragons
items.intro: Betrayed by her prince and hunted by her own sister, Princess Evelyn marries a humble fisherman to keep her claim to the throne. What she does not know is that her devoted husband is the legendary Dragon Lord, hiding his identity to avenge his parents. As royal schemes and forbidden magic threaten the kingdom, her unlikely marriage may be its greatest salvation.

items.title: A Gift of Love, A Lifetime Together
items.intro: A genius dropout is betrayed by her ex and juggles five jobs to raise her baby. On a rainy night, she stumbles into a billionaire's luxury car—unaware that the cute baby in her arms is actually his flesh and blood.

items.title: Cursed by Blood, Priceless to Her Billionaire Daddy
items.intro: Orphan Nova is abandoned by her cruel relatives and rescued by billionaire Alexander. She has a “lucky star” gift: seeing hidden treasures, sensing danger, and healing her stepbrother Caleb. As enemies attack, her past and Alexander’s late wife’s secrets surface.

items.title: Forbidden Office Hours
items.intro: She seduces her professor to uncover her mother's death—moving next door, turning his classroom into a game of desire. He knows he's crossing the line, yet keeps falling. The truth: her mother was killed by the chief surgeon, and she hated the wrong woman.

items.title: My Lame Duke Is So Good
