items.intro: A modern doctor transmigrates into villainess Isabella and refuses to divorce her cursed, disabled dragon duke Sebastian. She heals him with modern medicine and warmth; together they break the curse and quell war.

items.title: The Beast Whisperer
items.intro: Abandoned at three for having no beast-taming talent, Kael is raised by a hidden beast master and learns the ancient dragon-throat voice. Eighteen years later, he returns with a dragon-tooth whistle—and instantly subdues a raging lava dragon. But the mysterious blood in the whistle hides a shocking secret.

items.title: I Fell for the Wrong Twin
items.intro: Zoe dates gentle Blake until she meets his identical twin Ethan—her direct superior. Suffering amnesia and recognition impairment, Zoe keeps mixing them up. Ethan uses their resemblance to get closer. As memories resurface, she realizes the man in her dreams may have been Ethan all along.

items.title: I Drew My Swimmer Stepbrother's Body
items.intro: To investigate his father's death, Milo deliberately seduces his stepbrother Ethan, a competitive swimmer. What begins as a forbidden game turns dangerously real. Together, they take on the true mastermind behind it all and unearth a long-buried case.

items.title: Deep Sea Betrothal: The Wolf King and His Siren Bride
items.intro: Siren Princess Mia is sold into the black market by her first love and forcibly bought out by Alpha Ethan, who binds her with a contract. From resistance to surrender, the two join forces to crush her hypocritical ex. To save the sea clan and defy the curse of the oracle, Mia awakens as the Siren Queen while Ethan rebels against fate itself.

items.title: Death Whisper
items.intro: Rosa, the true Colonna heiress, was dumped as a baby while a false heir took her place. Touching her father’s coffin, she sees how everyone will die—including Dante, the rival Don she is destined to kill.

items.title: Bought by the Billionaire Surgeon
items.intro: To save her critically ill father, broke student Chloe dials the wrong number and "sells" herself to Ethan Sinclair—Northgate's coldest, most ruthless billionaire deputy chief of surgery. What she expects is a night of humiliation, but instead it unravels a four-year-old missing-person murder case among the wealthy, an international organ-trafficking ring, and one man's mad possessiveness willing to die for her.

items.title: Taming My Cursed Dragon Lord
items.intro: Dragon King Sali bears a deadly lunar curse. Wounded, he meets fox princess Rafina—his fated cure. Betrayed by her fiancé and family, Rafina is rescued by Sali. Their soul bond breaks the curse; they defeat traitors and marry.

items.title: Daughter of the Sea: The LittleGirl' s Journey Home
items.intro: Six-year-old orphan Ella has healing magic and can talk to sea creatures. She saves heir Liam and is taken into Smith Manor. Adopted daughter Claire schemes against her. When the family curse is revealed, Ella’s crescent birthmark proves she is the true Moon Witch—and she breaks the curse.

items.title: Bound to the Dragon King
items.intro: Camilla, a hidden-witch princess, is betrayed by her clan and sent as a tribute to the cruel North. Bound by a soul contract with dragon lord Varrik, she embarks on a fifteen-year journey of revenge and redemption—rising from weak maid to supreme witch.

items.title: My Bodyguard Is Satan
items.intro: When vampires target Alice to resurrect Dracula, her dying mother sacrifices her own soul to summon Satan. Bound by the pact, the King of Hell descends to protect Alice, posing as her personal bodyguard while hiding his true identity—even from her. To everyone around him, he’s just an arrogant nobody. But as powerful enemies close in and forbidden feelings ignite, those who dare look down on him will discover that even Hell bows before him.

items.title: Her Soul Is a Siren
items.intro: Princess Freya is betrayed by her family and sacrificed to the sea god. She gives her soul to an ancient Siren for vengeance. The Siren returns in her body, exposing the royals—but a blood curse prevents her from killing blood relatives.

items.title: Till Death Do Us Part And I Choose Death
items.intro: Once a rising Hollywood star, Brenda Taylor gave up her dreams for her husband, powerful film producer and director George Taylor. But when he betrays her with an Oscar-winning actress and even their son turns against her, Brenda decides to take the ultimate revenge. She fakes her own death, leaving her family drowning in guilt and regret. But as Brenda embraces a new life of freedom, George’s grief turns into a dangerous obsession, and he’ll stop at nothing to get her back.

items.title: My Dangerous Lover
items.intro: Desperate to pay her mother's medical bills, Caroline Miller takes a job on a gambling ship, where she witnesses mob boss Jacob Camorra commit murder. To buy her life, she is forced to surrender herself to him for one night. When she is later sold by her ex into a deadly hunting ground, Jacob saves her but claims her as his own, using her mother's safety to force her into an engagement. Trapped in his estate, can she break free from a man who refuses to let her go?

items.title: My Sister is the Dragon Queen
items.intro: To the nobles at her sister's betrothal, Saria is just a lowly servant. In truth, she's the Dragon Queen, the most powerful mage in the empire. When a ruthless fiancé and a jealous princess threaten Lysa, Saria unleashes her ancient ice dragon to protect the sister she raised—and make everyone who wronged them bow.

items.title: Of Incubus and the Fall-Saint
items.intro: A modern youth becomes Adrian, the last male incubus, imprisoned with corrupted Holy Son Elias. He purifies Elias, disguises as a Holy Maiden, and joins forces with him against the Pope to save his race.

items.title: Heir to the Pride, Heir to My Heart
items.intro: Fox girl Naya is forced into a Golden Lion Mark with lion heir Vette and secretly bears his son. She becomes the prince's wet nurse and endures humiliation from false saint Serena. When the truth blazes, she leaves—and Vette begins a humble wife-chasing crematorium.

items.title: Reply, My Lucky Star（DUBBED）
items.intro: Treated as a curse rather than a blessing, the lucky star is denied a name and abandoned by her debt-ridden family after unknowingly giving away her fortune to them. When ruthless loan shark Kim Hyeon-uk arrives to collect the debt, he takes her in and names her Choi Bok-hee. As the two travel together in search of treatment for Bok-hee's brain tumor, they cross paths with kind-hearted strangers who help mend the wounds no medicine can cure.

items.title: Kicked Out Pregnant, Married Back Rich（DUBBED）
items.intro: Because of a misunderstanding, Emma Moore becomes pregnant with the child of the richest man in the country, William Bermont. While raising the child alone, she suffers constant bullying from her aunt, who steals her inheritance. After William finds her, he stands up for her. Later, Emma helps him overcome a major corporate crisis and discovers her long-lost brother has become the richest man in Eastoria. With two powerful men by her side, Emma turns her life around.

items.title: He Who Shatters the Divine Order（DUBBED）
items.intro: After awakening a useless dark serpent, Wayne Yeager is cast out by his fiancée and sect. Bound by a blood pact, he rises through devouring and evolution. Along his harsh journey, he meets a sword immortal and a strange, ugly bird, surviving deadly realms and battles. Betrayed by the hypocrisy of the immortal world, he fuses with the serpent, becomes the sovereign, shatters the heavens, and rewrites his fate.

items.title: The Dangerous Heir（DUBBED）
items.intro: After losing her parents and everything she owns overnight, Kang Seo-yeon spends 15 years plotting revenge as Kim Yoo-jin, the adopted daughter of her enemy, Kim Do-hyung. When his son, Lee Jae-hyun, returns home, she draws him in carefully. As their dangerous game turns into real feelings, Jae-hyun falls deeply in love and even opposes Do-hyung for her sake. But when the truth comes out, he realizes he has been a pawn all along. Will he stand by Yoo-jin or turn against her?

items.title: Loving You Was My Mistake（DUBBED）
items.intro: After years of unwavering devotion and selfless love, David Smith is finally ready to make Sara Miller his wife. In a final act of faith, he asks his father to invest billions into her company, hoping to secure her future and propel her career. But just as the company is on the verge of its grand public debut, David uncovers a devastating truth: he was never her true choice—he was only her backup plan. The man she truly desires is Ian Brown.

items.title: Falling for My Bestie's Mafia Dad
items.intro: Sold by her ruthless relatives, orphaned Faye thought her life was over—until Darius, a powerful mafia boss, rescued her. Cold and impossible to approach, he gives her the protection she always dreamed of. But as she falls for the man who saved her, she uncovers a devastating secret: Darius is her best friend's biological father. Their love was forbidden from the start. Can Faye escape a love she was never meant to have—or will the truth bind them forever?

items.title: Backseat Swap: Trapped with His best Friend
items.intro: Every bump in the road pulls Annie closer to Elias—her husband Cain's best friend, and completely off-limits. Up front, her best friend Raven is making a bold play for Cain right under her nose. It all started with one "amnesia" joke an hour ago. Cain pushed Elias toward her—"He's your husband"—then flirted with Raven without shame. Stunned, Annie keeps playing along. The SUV rolls on, and every jolt rattles her composure. Elias is nowhere near as unaffected as he pretends.

items.title: Bye, Ex! Done Being Your Second Choice
items.intro: Yale Levin gives up his family, fortune, and future for Mia Hunt, only to spend seven years watching her put Zach Jaffe first. After one betrayal too many, Yale walks away and returns to the life he abandoned. Now, with devoted heiress Wendy Blair ready to marry him, Yale is reclaiming everything he lost, and no amount of regret can make him look back.

items.title: He Called Me a Gold Digger Then My Brother Walked In
items.intro: At Westbridge University, Bella Morris is branded a gold digger when rival Alice exposes proof of a sugar daddy and steals the Freshman Honors Award. The truth: her 'sugar daddy' is star quarterback Henry Walker, her brother, and the 'rich old man' is her father, the board chairman. Bella takes the livestream stage and reclaims her name alone.

items.title: The Power Chose Me: I Rule the World
items.intro: Dark and White Mages war over Lux Ultima, a sentient book granting world-altering power to its chosen master. Kai Draven, four-element mage, leaves his foster mentors to find his birth parents by a family crest. Saving the Solaryns from raiders, he senses a blood bond—lost kin. Seized by the Dark Mage Alliance, Kai bonds with Lux Ultima, passes its trials, awakens power, storms the Dark Temple, outwits a power-copying tyrant, frees both families, and reclaims his identity.

items.title: Angel King, Claim Your Daughter
items.intro: One reckless night with Cassian, the Angel King, left hotel cleaner Nora Hale raising their half-blood angel daughter in secret. Five years later she returns with her child, and the Council and jealous rivals close in. For Cassian, claiming his daughter and the mate he never stopped wanting is worth burning heaven down.

items.title: My Mechanic Husband Is a Mafia Boss
items.intro: Her boyfriend dumped her for a rich woman. So she married a stranger—a broke mechanic she met on the street. He's kind. He's protective. He's poor. That's what she thinks. But when her mother gets framed and the men who hurt her come back, this quiet mechanic makes one phone call. And the whole city kneels.

items.title: The Pirate Queen Tames Her Five Beastly Husbands
items.intro: Pirate queen Lora died at the hands of the five beast husbands she enslaved. Reborn on the night she first hurt them, she has thirty days to break her curse by gathering five shards that also unlock their collars. Her deal: sail the Seven Seas with her, and be free. Slowly, five proud beasts learn the queen they hated will never leave them behind.

items.title: Rejected By the Lycan King, Return with His Triplets
items.intro: Deceived by a false prophecy, Lycan King Varek rejects his fated mate, Grace. A year later, she returns to his kingdom with his secret triplets to save their dying daughter. As Varek closes in on the truth, Grace fights to escape—while desire, distrust, and their unbroken bond keep pulling them back together.

items.title: Doomsday Dino Tyrant
items.intro: When dinosaurs return, human civilization is wiped out.Sam awakens the power to control them—only to discover his fiancée has been sleeping with his best friend. Together, they shoot Sam dead. But Sam is reborn one week before the dinosaur apocalypse. This time, he’ll use his power to become the ruler of the dinosaur age.

items.title: My Wife Brought Home a Bastard, So I Dropped the Act
items.intro: Vampire-werewolf hybrid Soren has spent years hiding his true power behind the title of Grand Marshal. When his wife Lydia betrays him and the empire turns on him, he stops holding back. One by one he crushes his enemies, exposes the traitors, and takes back everything that was stolen from him.

items.title: The Golden-Eyed Monster Was The Pure-Blood Luna
items.intro: Born with golden eyes, Elara is branded a curse and hunted by her own pack. Saved by an Alpha, she marries his son Darius and secretly guards the pack with her Pure-Blood Luna power. Then Darius rejects her for her sister Sylvara, a fraud, and Elara is sold on the black market. Her buyer is Caelan, a hidden Lycan prince with a throne-hungry brother. As the barrier falls and enemies close in, Elara must claim her power, her bloodline and the crown, and choose who becomes king.

items.title: Halloween Horror Night Game: Tempt the Vampire to Survive
items.intro: Trapped in a Halloween amusement park when every exit seals shut, college student Nadia is bound to a deadly romance survival game run by Damien, a cursed vampire boss. To survive the carousel, haunted house, Ferris wheel, mirror maze and more, she must complete intimate tasks to keep his hunger in check. But forced seduction slowly turns into real love, and when their bond hits 100%, only true love can break his century-old curse and set them both free.

items.title: My Four Wolves Dared Me to Leave
items.intro: By an ancient law, human girl Ayla Thorne is bound to the Silvermoon pack instead of the Moonbane heir and tied to four wolf lords who treat her as an obligation, not a mate. When they dare her to leave, she walks out and swears herself to the Ashland Watch for five years. Only then do Kaden, Kael, Cedric and Damian grasp what they lost.

items.title: Falling for My Husband's Mafia Brother
items.intro: Pregnant Ivy watches her husband, George, get murdered before her eyes. After his funeral, her mother-in-law takes her to the Harcourt mafia estate in New York, where George's brother, Edward, treats her with contempt. When Ivy's gambling-addicted brother kidnaps her to force an abortion, Edward saves her by killing the captor. Bound by guilt and protection, Ivy and Edward develop unexpected feelings and ultimately find love as they welcome the family's new heir.

items.title: Call My Pups Bastards? They Are Royal Heirs!
items.intro: Seven years after being betrayed, poisoned, and cast into the rogue wilderness, Grace is forced to return as a surrogate for the sister who stole her place. But she is no longer helpless—and the four “bastard” pups at her side are royal heirs. When their powerful parents and Grace’s true mate, the Supreme Lycan King, arrive, her enemies must face the deadly consequences of their cruelty.

items.title: I Saved a Snake, Then Had the Dragon King’s Twins
items.intro: Elizabeth, a woodland healer, saves a dying white serpent and learns it is Constantine, an amnesiac dragon king. One night leaves her with two dragon eggs, and she raises the twins alone. When Constantine returns with no memory, hunters of the dragon throne close in. She must guard her children and wake the king before her family is torn apart.

items.title: The Dragon Princess of Dragon-Slaying Academy
items.intro: Dragon princess Lia gets "donated" into a human academy by her lovestruck father. Taken in by the broke but fiercely devoted mentors of the Dragon-Slaying Academy, she gets spoiled rotten in the most hilariously frugal way possible. And when the time comes, she reveals her true form and absolutely wrecks every evil dragon in her path.

items.title: Reborn as a succubus, I Drained the Angel King Dry
items.intro: Reborn as a succubus inside an angel's body, Lilia needs sacred fire to survive, and the celibate Seraph King Kyle is the only source. She schemes her way onto his throne and he burns for her. When war comes and her demon blood is exposed, Kyle stands with her against the council, and the two forge a pact that crowns them both.

items.title: Secrets of the Heir's Night
items.intro: Country girl Elowen is drugged by her sister Sylvia and sold at an underground auction—until Kian, head of the Northern family, saves her. For ten years, he secretly protects her and shapes her into top designer "Voss." Facing a biased mother, a fake heiress, and a forced engagement, Elowen reveals she is Voss. Sylvia's kidnap plot backfires, and the "mother" is exposed as her real mother's twin. Reunited with her true mother, Elowen starts anew with Kian.

items.title: The Earth Lord Comes Home
items.intro: Galactic Marshal Marek Solaris, the strongest warrior alive, returns to Earth hiding his power with wife Ceres and daughter Mira in her family home, where the in-laws scorn him as a useless son-in-law. When his hundred Stellar Tridents descend over the Sterling mansion, the family learns who they mocked, and Marek must decide how far he will go.

items.title: Olympus: Return of the Forgotten Princess
items.intro: Astraea returns to Olympus to save the mortal world, facing Melirona's schemes and her own family's rejection—but after enduring every humiliation, she earns a chance to enter the High Temple by saving Melirona's life. In the final trial, she stops an attack with one hand and unleashes a golden shockwave that makes the temple resonate, finally proving to Zeus that the daughter he scorned is the true master chosen by the Thunder.

items.title: The XXL Wife He Killed Is Back—Now He's at My Feet
items.intro: Framed by her husband Oscar and her best friend Annie, overweight heiress Zoe is pushed off a cliff. She survives, transforms herself and returns under a new identity. Living close to her enemies, she dismantles their alliance, reclaims her name and inheritance, and sends the killers to prison.

items.title: The Alpha’s Monster Bride
items.intro: Sienna, a succubus scrapped for being too much to handle, wakes in the body of the Ashfords' long-lost daughter, brought home only to die in her sister's place. Sent into the Blood Moon Hunt, she meets Damian, the feral Alpha every woman fears. Instead of breaking her, he cannot get enough, and together they burn down the family that used her.

items.title: Hearing the Cat's Thoughts, I Uncovered My Fiancé's Betrayal
items.intro: On the eve of quitting her job, Scarlett discovers she can hear her new cat's thoughts—and it has plenty to say. Her fiancé is sleeping with her best friend, they forged her medical report, and they plan to steal her promotion and live off her money. Armed with every secret her cat uncovers, Scarlett tears up her resignation. If they want her life, they'll have to watch her take theirs apart first.

items.title: My Mafia Ex Forgot Me—But Still Wanted Me
items.intro: Viola and Cage are signing their divorce papers after three years of marriage when a shootout between their men leaves them both with amnesia. Strangers again, they are fed lies by their own people and forced back into the same mansion. Clashing over every rule, they find their bodies remember what their minds forgot.

items.title: They Buried Me at My Sister's Wedding
items.intro: At her sister's beach wedding, Ivy is buried in wet sand as a joke. Her brothers laugh. The groom—her ex—walks away. The tide rises. They don’t save her. Dead, she watches them discover the truth: she never killed their mother. A devastating story of family cruelty, buried lies, and a love that comes too late.

items.title: Careful—That Wolf Pup Can Call Down Lightning!
items.intro: Three-year-old Dora is the laughingstock of Silvercrest Pack: a "dumb" pup who cannot shift and speaks one word at a time. No one knows she carries the memories of the pack's legendary founding Alpha. When a corrupt enforcer condemns her father and threatens to wipe out her family, Dora drops the act. One spell calls down silver lightning—and exposes a power that could shake the entire Lycan States.

items.title: They Humiliated the Wrong Elf Heiress
items.intro: Eira returns to the elven family that finally found her, only to be treated like a penniless stray. They favor their adopted daughter, force Eira to give up her inheritance, and even demand she kneel in public. What they don't know is that Eira has spent eighteen years earning the loyalty of the continent's most powerful bear, merfolk, and wolf nobles. When they arrive to defend her, the family that cast her aside discovers too late who they tried to humiliate.

items.title: I Woke Up as the Dragon Prince's Evil Consort
items.intro: Rowan drowns saving a girl and wakes inside the body of a snow leopard prince in a dragon-ruled empire, married to Crown Prince Cassian and father to an eight-year-old daughter he never knew. Instead of the original Rowan’s cruelty, he chooses kindness, and slowly the child, the palace and Cassian begin to believe he has really changed.

items.title: Always His Second Choice
items.intro: On Clara's 4th anniversary, a framed photo reveals her fiancé Damian has had 100 dates with her best friend Blair. For years, Clara was his second choice—Blair took her seat, her room, his protection. When Blair breaks her father's watch and ruins her design, Damian forces Clara to sign a settlement, using her late father's studio as leverage. Clara stops begging to be chosen. She signs, leaves her ring with Blair, and flies to London one-way. He'll learn too late.

items.title: Gold Digger With 4 Sugar Daddies? They're My Dad & Brothers
items.intro: Stella Brooks is falsely smeared as a golddigger with four sugar daddies at her university award ceremony. Photos and edited texts make the whole campus believe she manipulates four wealthy men for money and favors. But those socalled sugar daddies are actually her father, the university chancellor, and her three elder brothers.

items.title: Move! The Reclaimed Girl Is Here to Shield Her Billionaire Family
items.intro:
I was abandoned as a child and raised by the most feared Mafia boss in the world. By nine, I could dismantle weapons, break bones, and make enemies beg for mercy.
But when my billionaire birth family finally found me, I discovered they were being crushed by a powerful rival family. They thought I was just a fragile little girl...
They were wrong. I’m not here to fit into their world. I’m here to destroy anyone who dares hurt my family.

items.title: Betrayed at Sea, I Awoke the Sea God's Compass
items.intro: Young sailor Ethan Raine is betrayed by his uncle Rex and cast into a raging storm. At death’s door, he rescues cursed sea‑princess Xiya and awakens the Sea‑God’s Compass, gaining power to summon sunken ships and ghost fleets. Returning with a treasure ship to exact revenge, he is pulled into black‑market deals and sea‑monster battles, unearthing Admiral Iron Crown’s heinous plot to murder the Sea Emperor.

items.title: My Husbands Betrayed Me—So I Married Three Wolf Princes
items.intro: Betrayed by her husband and the dowager on the night she was murdered, Evelyn wakes back in her past life. She tears up the marriage pact, reclaims her mother's sapphire bracelet and moves into a ruined border house, where three wounded werewolf princes hide. Healing them with awakened water magic, she is drawn into the pack's war for the throne.

items.title: They Laid Off the Savior
items.intro: In 2100, volcanic upheavals awaken colossal monsters, pushing humanity to the brink. Titan Group races to build giant intelligent mechs, led by chief engineer and world-class hacker Bryan Smith. But on acting chairwoman Alexandra Sloan’s first day, she mistakes him for a useless connection hire and fires him for sleeping after an all-nighter. Worse, she elevates fraudulent engineer Ryan Smith, who discovers Bryan is “XOmaster”—the online genius Sloan secretly admires......

items.title: My Dragon Husband Killed My Brother
items.intro: Renowned healer Linnea loses everything when her dragon husband, Rowan, allows Vanessa—the woman he has always protected—to kill her brother and destroy her magic. After uncovering the lies behind their marriage, Linnea escapes and rebuilds her life as a healer. But when Rowan finally realizes what he has lost, her heart may already belong to Soren, the dragon who chooses her without hesitation.

items.title: The Lunar Cage The Forbidden Alpha
items.intro: Betrayed by her fiancé Aemon, pure-blood moon descendant Lyra wanders into the forbidden forest on a full moon night and heals cursed Alpha Kael. They trigger a fated bond. The engagement rite at Grey Castle proves a sacrificial trap set by Elder Alden and Aemon to awaken the "Ancestral Seal." With her family held hostage and the altar opened, Lyra refuses to be a pawn—she awakens her pure-blood origin and fights beside Kael, tearing through bloodline and conspiracy to rewrit

items.title: Odyssey: The Shipwright's Epic
items.intro: Achilles, conqueror of Epirus, hides as a shipwright for five years. When Trojans raid the port, Queen Helen shields him. To repay her, he enters the arena, defeats Trojan warriors and Paris, and reveals he is Greece's lost greatest warrior.

items.title: The Bookworm and the Playboy
items.intro: Book smart nerd Iris gets turned down by a boy when she confesses her love, with him rejecting her for lacking romantic experience. To make up for this shortcoming, she approaches Nash, the campus playboy, and asks him to teach her about love and intimacy. The two start out in a contractual teaching and learning relationship. Amid intimate moments and daily banter, genuine feelings blossom between them. Meanwhile, the boy who once rejected Iris comes back to pursue her, spark

items.title: The Dreamwalker's Guide to Love
items.intro: Cathy, a psychology student with chronic insomnia, is transported every night through a mysterious AI pillow to Liam, the university's arrogant star swimmer—whose confidence hides family pressure and a buried doping scandal. As they uncover the truth and heal old wounds, they learn that love isn't about saving someone—it's about giving them the courage to save themselves.

items.title: All Mortals, All Heroes
items.intro: General Ciels Gner defeats the orc forces and is appointed Grand Marshal. After ten years away, he returns home—only to be publicly humiliated at his family banquet by his fiancée Lina, who breaks off their engagement. When an orc warrior kills innocents and insults the Empire, Ciels kills him with his silver-white dragon spear. His true identity is revealed.

items.title: The Witch and the Wolf King
items.intro: Leora, once the noble heiress of the Roy family, was framed by her stepmother Margaret and cousin Gideon as "mentally ill" and locked in a remote asylum for five years. In despair, her witch godmother Morgana awakened her innate witch bloodline and taught her magic, potions, and combat. Five years later, reborn Leora returns. A misunderstanding leads her into the Connic family—a mafia werewolf clan ruling the city's underworld—where on a full moon night she saves......

items.title: I'll Steal You Back
items.intro: Emily Smith, in an attempt to save her ill boyfriend Daniel Oster, borrowed money from her former suitor, wealthy businessman James Irman. However, she was forced to marry him and was prohibited from getting a divorce. Emily deceived Daniel, telling him that she married James for money, in order to trick him into ending their relationship.

items.title: Married with My Secret Boss
items.intro: Lynn escapes her toxic family after a one-night stand with a stranger. He finds her and proposes; they flash-marry. She later learns his first love is his stepmother—and his gentle facade hides a darker side.

items.title: Fated to the Demon Who Owns My Stolen Heart
items.intro: Elvira is murdered by her father and stepmother, but her dying blood awakens Lucian—a demon sealed for a thousand years—and she accidentally takes his heart, binding them in a blood contract. As she uses his power to reclaim her mother's trust fund while he plots to take back his heart, her past-life memories reveal that she was the Oracle who sealed him—and that the ancient betrayal may hold a different truth.

items.title: I Delivered to Gods
items.intro: Former racing champion Jack sells his soul to demon boss Morgana to save his sister. He becomes a delivery driver across god realms, collects soul fragments, gains divine powers, and uncovers a chaos apocalypse sealed for ten thousand years.

items.title: Too Late to Say I Love You
items.intro: Caitlin feigned an affair to raise money for her mother's medical treatment and broke up with her lover Francis. After Francis inherited a huge fortune, he reunited with Caitlin but kept humiliating her due to misunderstandings. Caitlin concealed the truth of her pregnancy and faced family marriage pressure, career crises, and her mother's interference. Despite the numerous difficulties, the two remained deeply in love.

items.title: The Betrayed Mother is the Divine Heiress
items.intro: Twenty-five years ago, Lena Sinclair—High Strategos of the Order of Aegis and chosen inheritor of Athena’s divine power—failed to save her biological son Lucas from a raging fire. She watched helplessly as he perished, and the guilt of that day haunted her ever since. Not long after, another fire broke out in a hospital. Lena, risking her own life, charged into the flames and rescued seven infants from the EICU.

items.title: The Scent That Made Him Mine
items.intro: Their love was sealed with a kiss in the perfumery, but a family conspiracy turned it into a curse. She “betrayed” him to settle debts; he “died” in a crash. Five years later, she’s a down-and-out job seeker, while he’s the dashing heir of a conglomerate. When a perfume bottle shatters, the familiar scent unravels secrets — the locked room, the staged betrayal. Who’s pulling the strings? Click to witness the electrifying showdown between love and revenge!

items.title: My Husband Is the Father of Her Son
items.intro: After ten years of marriage, billionaire heiress Kate discovers her “perfect” husband Owen has been living a double life and secretly fathered another woman’s child.When the mistress publicly humiliates her and twists the story, Kate decides she’s done playing the good wife.In front of everyone, how will Kate rip off Owen’s mask, expose him as the cheating gold-digger he really is, and reclaim her place in the most powerful family in the country?

items.title: Stepmonster VS. Daddy's Darling
items.intro: Anita Lowen, the only daughter of biotech tycoon Victor Lowen, returns home from Africa, only to have her life violently derailed on the day she arrives. Hoping to secure her place in the Lowen family, Victor's secretary and fiancée, Serena, brings a priceless virus sample meant as a gift for Anita. But when Anita saves a child from Serena’s speeding car, the sample is destroyed.

items.title: Never Judge a Housewife（DUBBED）
items.intro: Once a top student, Claire Hayes becomes a housewife and quietly attends a reunion, eating shrimp while classmates mock her. Tessa Price boasts about working at Orion Group and humiliates Claire for relying on her “unsuccessful” husband. Claire stays calm, knowing her husband is on his way. When Ethan Hayes walks in, everyone is stunned. He is the owner of the billion-dollar Orion Group that Tessa had been bragging about.

items.title: The Blind Wife's Revenge
items.intro: Heiress Calliope is blinded in a car crash—arranged by her husband Darien. After catching him with Zinnia, she is locked in a freezer and dies. Reborn, she learns her accident was planned and begins her revenge.

items.title: Stumbling into Elite Academy, IJust Want to Make Money
items.intro: Chloe, a poor but brilliant scholarship student, treats wealthy classmates as clients to earn tuition. Ambitious rival Mia tries to marry heir Aston and bullies Chloe—but fails every time. Chloe wins respect, gets into Harvard, and gets engaged to Aston.

items.title: Lucifer's Death Row Bride
items.intro: Elena, a slave in the Kree Kingdom, is forced to marry Lucifer in place of Princess Victoria. Her blood unexpectedly soothes Lucifer's curse, drawing them into a thousand-year-old mystery. From sacrifice to queen, she refuses to let her identity decide her fate—and together they end the sacrifice system.

items.title: Mommy, The Ocean Emperor is My Daddy!
items.intro: Single mother Siena's son Leo has a rare illness with three months to live. The only hope is finding his biological father. Dante, CEO of Ocean Group, is secretly the Sea Emperor—and Leo is his son. Obsessed noblewoman Valentina tries to kill them. Together they fight and earn a hard-won happily-ever-after.

items.title: The Mage's Oath Belongs to Another World
items.intro: To resurrect his wife and daughter, the Archmage Mason signs a ten-year pact, becoming the servant of noblewoman Sophia, enduring endless humiliation. When the contract ends, he returns to his true family. Sophia and her daughter, Luna, regret their cruelty and cling to him in vain. Mason ultimately quells a dark magic rebellion, reunites with his loved ones, while Sophia loses everything and is stripped of her nobility.

items.title: Return of the Godfather
items.intro: Frank, North America’s supreme godfather, hides as a mechanic for five years, supporting his wife Natasha—only to be betrayed. At the White Queen Hotel banquet, he reveals his identity, settles scores, and rescues Vivian.

items.title: Return of the Bay Area Don
items.intro: After an attack killed his wife, New York’s feared Godfather vanished and raised Ellie on a quiet farm. Years later, a spoiled heiress humiliates and frames her at school. When Ellie is pushed too far, her gentle father reveals his true identity. Black cars arrive. Hundreds kneel. They thought they targeted a nobody. Instead, they awakened the Godfather—and doomed everyone who hurt his daughter.

items.title: The Secret of Widow's Bay
items.intro: Spring, 1944. In Widow's Bay, a salt-bitten coastal town almost devoid of men, twelve-year-old Eva Constance's mother holds Bible readings for the widows every Wednesday in a locked cellar. When a deserter vanishes from their home, Eva vows to uncover the secret every widow in town has sworn to keep. What lies under the locked cellar?

items.title: Locked in Marriage with the Man Who Jailed Me
items.intro: Elena Hawthorne, the lost Hawthorne heiress raised by her foster father Nathan Reed, once gave all her love to Damian Blackwell, the ruthless heir of Blackwell Holdings. Five years ago, after a drugged night Damian never remembered correctly, he believed Vanessa Ellison was the woman who had been with him and made her his fiancée. When Vanessa was later left supposedly comatose after a hit-and-run, Elena was framed for the crime.

items.title: The Man Who Saved the Titanic
items.intro: After sacrificing himself to save 327 soldiers, elite aircraft carrier captain Chris awakens in 1912 aboard the historic Titanic, just 150 minutes before it strikes an iceberg. Hired to replace the ailing captain, he must battle a power-hungry first officer who refuses to slow down. Can Chris defy history and save over 2,000 lives before the legendary ship sinks?

items.title: Too Late to See the Love I Lost
items.intro: Six years ago, Paige Allen gave her corneas to save her husband, Zeke Floyd. Left blind and believed dead, she raises their daughter, Hailey, alone. When Paige crosses paths with Zeke again, he is still mourning the wife standing before him, yet fails to recognize her as his family tears mother and child apart. As the truth surfaces, Paige must decide whether the man she sacrificed everything for deserves another chance.

items.title: Run, Mommy! Into the Light
items.intro: Abducted and sold to a brutal man, Monica Carpel spends ten years trapped in a remote village. Her daughter, Nina Carpel, risks her life to help her escape. Reunited with her wealthy family, Monica returns to rescue Nina and make their abusers pay. But her daughter has vanished, and the villagers are hiding what happened to her. Can Monica bring home the little girl who gave her a chance at freedom?

items.title: The Deity's Temptation
items.intro: Desert drought grips the human realm, so Nefara is offered to Setekh, god of storms. Fate betrays her: she gives herself to Rameshel, the Sun God, awakening his forbidden desire. Humiliated by Setekh and framed by the goddess Hathira, she unveils her sacred mark and defies the ancient law to become his queen.

items.title: They Called Me a Nerd, Until I Stepped Into the Ring
items.intro: They called Ivy Harrington the only disgrace in a dynasty of boxing champions—the nearsighted nerd who couldn't dodge a punching bag. No one knows that in a past life, she retired undefeated after 108 wins. When a rival family ambush leaves her champion siblings broken and a killing blow targets her sister, Ivy steps into the ring. The Harringtons have one last fighter—and she has never lost.

items.title: You Take My Crown, I Ruin Your Empire
items.intro: Dragon knight Edward returns from ten years guarding the North, only to be jilted by Empress Selena and her lover Duke Delacroix, stripped of his dragon command and sword, and cast out. Quietly, he lifts the dragon Titan's ten seals and recalls his knights. He alone can tame Titan, and he is the Dragon Lord the Dragon Sage sought for three years. As Delacroix's treason unravels, Edward exposes him, burns him, dethrones Selena, severs their soul bond, and flies off as king.

items.title: The Dragon Lord is Dying to Keep Me Safe
items.intro: Fired dragon tamer Elena is struck by the Dragon Lord Cain's black dragon and wakes unable to feel pain, while every wound she takes burns through him a thousand times over. He hides her in his castle to keep her alive. As they fall for each other, a drug ring that controls dragons surfaces, and Elena fights beside the man who feels all her pain.

items.title: My Forbidden Baby at Coven Academy
items.intro: At a witch academy where pregnancy is forbidden, witchling Clara spends one night with the last Dragon King, Kane—and ends up pregnant. Desperate to protect her baby, she hides her secret. Then Kane arrives as her new professor, searching for the only woman who can touch him. When Clara's bullies expose her pregnancy and threaten her baby, Kane discovers the truth: his student is the woman he’s been searching for—and she's carrying his child.

items.title: The Disabled Girl He Mocked is Now a Queen. He Regrets It
items.intro: Chloe Hart gave up Stanford for a dare-date with star quarterback Aiden Montgomery, then overheard him mocking her limp and planning to leak her photos. She takes an Oxford scholarship and rebuilds herself into someone untouchable. The crippled girl he despised returns a queen, and Aiden can only watch her rise beyond his reach.

items.title: The Alpha's Hidden Silver Moon
items.intro: Elena Moore meets Adrian, the powerful Alpha werewolf, on a bloodmoon night. The two become fated mates and share a passionate night together. Upon waking up, Adrian mistakes Elena for a paid woman arranged by his mother and offers her money to leave. Unexpectedly, Elena gets pregnant one month later. After Elena is betrayed and kidnapped by her adoptive parents, Adrian learns he has misunderstood her and rushes to rescue her…

items.title: I Choose You, My Merfolk Husband
items.intro: After losing her life to the man she trusted, Luna awakens on the final day of her marriage bond with Keal, a merfolk prince who died to save her. Given a second chance, she vows to choose the husband she once rejected. But her ruthless ex, Owen, will stop at nothing to steal Keal's royal power. As deadly traps close in and a mysterious life force binds them, can Luna rewrite their fate without sacrificing the man she loves again?

items.title: XXXL Wife, Ruthless Comeback
items.intro: Jessica, a severely overweight woman, discovers that her husband despises her body and has been cheating on her with her best friend, with the two conspiring to deceive her. Determined to turn her life around, she loses weight, transforms into a stunning beauty, and meets Alexander, a handsome, wealthy man—leaving her ex-husband regretting everything.

items.title: To Save My Daughter, I Disinherited My Four Adopted Sons!
items.intro: When Eleanor Hale discovers the four adopted sons she raised used her power to torment her own daughter, Audrey, she strips them of their cards, jobs, and place in the family. They think Hale Global cannot survive without them. They have no idea Eleanor built an empire—and the men who rule Wall Street still answer to her. This time, protecting Audrey means making her ungrateful sons lose everything.

items.title: She Stole My Mate, I Married the Dragon King
items.intro: Betrayed by her sister and rejected by her fated mate, Evelyn loses everything—until death grants her a second chance. This time, she chooses a seemingly powerless drifter over the man who ruined her life. But her new husband hides a deadly secret: he is the lost Dragon King. As ancient powers awaken and enemies close in, Evelyn must reclaim her destiny and discover if love can survive a kingdom built on lies.

items.title: The Chatty Woman Everyone Mocks Heals Her Silent Stepson
items.intro: Chatty Chloe marries billionaire Alexander Hart to pay off her family's debt, becoming stepmother to six-year-old Ethan, silent since his mother died three years ago. While the Harts push him through rigid therapy, Chloe enters his world with whimsical stories—broken glass becomes failed divers, crooked roofs lean toward the moon. Ethan inches closer until he finally speaks: "Mommy, don't go." Her chatter heals a silent child and awakens unexpected love.

items.title: At 260 Pounds, I Married My Fiancé’s Uncle
items.intro: Once mocked at over 260 pounds, Karlie returns home transformed—and discovers her boyfriend Dylan spent a year fake-dating her to avenge her sister. He has prepared a dog cage, a public humiliation, and a million-dollar bet, unaware Karlie is Mercer's new CEO. When an old marriage clause threatens her control of the company, Karlie chooses Dylan's powerful uncle Dominic instead. What begins as a deal becomes the first love that truly chooses her.

items.title: Bullied For Being Plus Size, I Leave My Ex Begging
items.intro: After years of being bullied for her weight, Lena transforms her life with the help of her adoptive mother, legendary designer Vivienne. When her longtime boyfriend Mason reveals their seven-year romance began as a cruel bet with bully Vanessa, Lena exposes their lies, rises to stardom, and watches both tormentors destroy themselves as she becomes a celebrated actress and fashion heiress.

items.title: Fire Me? In My Own Rolls-Royce
items.intro: Imagine getting humiliated, robbed, and threatened with being fired—all by your own housekeeper! After returning from overseas, billionaire CEO Vivian Carter discovers her maid and spoiled son have stolen her Rolls-Royce and are posing as the city's elite. Mistaking Vivian for a poor employee, they humiliate her in public and even try to get her fired. But there's one little problem: the car, the fortune, and the entire company belong to HER. And she's done playing nice.

items.title: After Betrayal, I Crashed My Negotiator Husband's Career
items.intro: Chloe's husband, Luke, is the city’s top hostage negotiator—until he breaks his own rule and forces his pregnant wife to trade places with his ex. A bullet kills their unborn child, but Luke buries the truth to secure a promotion. Armed with secret recordings and deadly evidence from his past, Chloe sets out to expose the hero as a killer and destroy the career he sacrificed everything to build.

items.title: She Chose Her Lover Over Our Daughter—So I Took It All
items.intro: Ryan Cross, the world’s richest man, hides his identity to give his sick daughter Mia a normal life. When his wife Scarlett betrays Mia to save her lover’s nephew, Ryan’s hope for a happy family shatters. He unleashes his hidden empire, exposing their greed and destroying everything they hold dear. They thought he was a nobody. Now, they’ll learn what happens when they cross the wrong man.

items.title: My Alpha Chose His Bastard Over Our Son
items.intro: Claire, a Sacred Moon princess, hid her identity and married Alpha Kane. He and mistress Vivian poisoned her, stole her power, and killed her son Leo to protect their child. At the heir rite, Claire revealed herself, broke the mate bond, stripped Kane, and jailed Vivian. Guard Darius helped her heal; their sun-moon pact built a peaceful new wolf order.

items.title: The Long-Lost Alpha Princess Returns
items.intro: Reina Moon, a young Omega healer, sells blood-made potions to pay for her poisoned mother's treatment. Betrayed by her fiance Drake Blackclaw and robbed of her royal name by impostors, she fights her way through the Healing Academy. Once her Lycan bloodline awakens, the long-lost Alpha princess returns to claim her throne and heal every wolf.

items.title: The Alpha's Deadly Bride
items.intro: When her sister flees, heiress Rachel Moon must marry feared Alpha Patrick Nightwood, who allegedly killed his last Luna. Trapped in a contract marriage and a 30-day venom bet, she faces jealous rivals, kidnappings, and his vengeful fake-dead ex—only to discover Patrick's hidden tenderness. As danger forces them closer, Rachel and Patrick confront lies and find true love.

items.title: Fake Dating My Sexy Summer Rival
items.intro: When scholarship camper Audrey Taylor returns to the rich-kid summer camp that once expelled her, she fake-dates Noah Rhodes—the hot heir who helped ruin her childhood—to get revenge and survive her cheating ex, his vicious rich-girl ex, and his classist family. But when their fake summer fling turns into real love, her chances of getting into Stanford are at risk, and Noah gives up everything to choose her.

items.title: I Treated a Billionaire Like a Dog
items.intro: She thought she was dog-sitting for her brother. Instead, she found a blind, chained man with a tail. For two weeks, she fed him, muzzled him, walked him on a leash, and slept beside him. Then she learned the truth: she'd broken into the wrong apartment——she wants to run. But can she really escape her "puppy"?

items.title: The Dragon Sovereign They Mocked
items.intro: Rejected by his own fiancée and mocked as a worthless dragon, Ruffini walks away from a sacred marriage pact—only to be chosen by the beautiful heiress Fenara. Everyone thinks she's made the biggest mistake of her life. But Ruffini is no ordinary dragon. He's the legendary Dragon King, feared by the most powerful beings alive! As enemies plot their downfall, the fools who humiliated him are about to learn what happens when you provoke a king.

items.title: My Knight Freed Me From the Prince
items.intro: Eight years ago, jeweler Ella believed Prince Lucien saved her from a fire. Trapped in his workshop for years, she designs works another woman claims as her own. When Knight Commander Rowan returns from war, he follows the signature hidden in her work to find her. Together they expose the truth, and Ella reclaims her name, freedom, and love.

items.title: Four Dragon Lords Crave Their Human Bride
items.intro: Transported into a world of dragons, Nora is auctioned as a rare human female. Four Dragon Lords—ruthless Kael, cold scholar Lucien, gentle Soren, and blunt warrior Arthur—buy her together. Her calming presence soothes their tempers, and as she uncovers their hidden tenderness, she stops being a possession and becomes their chosen mate.

items.title: He Stole Me from the Altar, Then Threw Me Away for Her
items.intro: Helen was supposed to marry Edward, but Felix deliberately crashed into her car, and she lost her memory. Lying that he was her true love, Felix trapped her and stole five years of her life. Now his mistress Megan flaunts her pregnancy and Helen's stolen wedding ring to humiliate her in public. But Helen's memory returns—she remembers Edward and the truth. Striking back, she exposes Megan's lies and prepares to make Felix pay as she waits for her long-lost love to return.

items.title: Fake Heiress Wants to Die? But I'm a Copycat!
items.intro: Romy Sinclair has Mimetic Stress Disorder: under pressure, she uncontrollably copies others. When she returns to her wealthy biological family, their beloved adopted daughter, Bianca, weaponizes this condition against her. Trapped by lies, betrayal, and deadly schemes, Romy must reclaim her family, her inheritance, and the courage to stop being anyone’s copy.

items.title: Stole my alpha husband? OK! I Become Witch Supreme
items.intro: My sister stole my werewolf alpha husband—and sent me to suffer at Ravenmoor Academy. But after we both return to the past, she chooses him first, leaving me to claim the life she once destroyed. Then I awaken as a Supreme Witch, catch the eye of a dangerous pure-blood heir, and discover my ex-husband wants me back. With betrayal, curses, and a deadly prophecy closing in, can I rewrite my fate before history repeats itself?

items.title: One Forbidden Kiss with the Alpha
items.intro: Drugged by her stepmother and nearly sold to a noble, Princess Elena flees and kisses Kane, Alpha of the Moon Wolves, sealing a fated mate bond. Forced to wed his ailing brother, she awakens the Silver Moon Wolf within her, exposes the queen's plot to seize the throne, and learns to stand beside Kane as an equal.

items.title: They Messed With The Wrong Daughter-in-Law
items.intro: "Jisu married for pure love, hiding the fact that her family holds enormous power in politics and business.After enduring relentless abuse and humiliation from her in-laws—her mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and sister-in-law by marriage—she finally decides to reveal her true identity and take revenge."

items.title: A Class of Troublemakers? My Harvard Dream Team
items.intro: Poor top student, Erin, is sold by her parents to an elite academy for $80,000 and shown off as a poster child for educational fairness. Refusing to be a prop, she joins the school's abandoned F class and teams up with its rebellious leader to gather evidence against her parents and the foundation, reclaiming her Harvard admission and her own life.

items.title: He Buried Our Wedding—I Married His Rival
items.intro: On her wedding day, Wendy finds the ballroom turned into a memorial for her fiancé Carter's first love's father. She walks out and marries Carter's biggest rival, Alex. As she reclaims the resources she once gave Carter and exposes Anna's lies, their rushed marriage grows into real, equal love.

items.title: Bad Boy
items.intro: Bullied bookworm Sienna angrily kisses campus heartthrob Zane and spends a night with him. Thinking it's over, she moves with her mother into a blended family—and discovers Zane is her stepbrother. Under one roof, he falls first.

items.title: Slum Bride, Arms Queen
items.intro: Ivy, sole daughter of a North American arms tycoon, hides her identity to marry into European royalty. Betrayed by her husband Lucas and losing her child, she leaves. When war threatens, she returns as an arms queen—and Lucas gives up his throne to atone.

items.title: The Revenge Stream
items.intro: Ethan Hays, fiancé to Sophia Gray, witnesses a compromising moment between Victoria Gray and adopted son Brandon. Branded a jealous liar by the powerful Gray family, he's publicly humiliated and cast out. After a tragic incident, he returns to the engagement morning. Armed with foresight, he orchestrates a strategic revelation to protect Sophia, uphold integrity, and restore truth through undeniable proof.

items.title: My Hidden Lover Is the Dragon King
items.intro: Ballerina Eve is betrayed by her lover and stepsister and killed after assassinating the Dragon King. Reborn, she cuts ties, marries Dragon King Sebastian, and systematically punishes her stepmother, stepsister, and ex-lover—rising to Human Queen.

items.title: AI Tyrant's Fall
items.intro: Assassin Sera time-travels to a cyberpunk era where the tyrant she once hunted rules as a corporate god. With a hacker ally, she cuts digital chains—only to find the god is just the beginning.

items.title: The Blood Restorer
items.intro: Oil painting restorer Evelyn is crippled by rival Chloe and becomes a night guard at SCP Foundation’s Gallery 9. When a cursed painting goes berserk, her blood-painting awakens a divine restoration gift—taming monsters and captivating the mad executive Silas.

items.title: Hang On, Mama — The Billionaire I Found Is Here to Rescue You
items.intro: Six-year-old Junie finds her billionaire father Griffin on a snowy street. A necklace reveals her mother Wren is his lost love, now dying of leukemia. Griffin fights off the jealous Camille to reunite his family.

items.title: Her Lycan King, Her Moonlight
items.intro: Omega Elena is rejected and exiled by the Alpha. Rescued by former Lycan King Orion, she awakens healing powers that can cure his curse. As they fall in love, the old Alpha hunts her—can Orion break the curse and return?

items.title: Orc husbands, please spare me
items.intro: In a beast world, ugly, powerless Elowen is tricked into sleeping with her sister's six disabled orc husbands. Pregnant, she tries to abort—until she hears the baby's thoughts: her fiancé betrayed her, and the six orcs will become tribal kings.

items.title: Cold CEO's Wolf King Bodyguard
items.intro: Elena Vance, the cool and sharp CEO of a listed company, is an outcast Beta from a fallen wolf pack. Raising her half-blood son Leo alone, she no longer believes in love and only fights for a stable life for herself and her child. The quiet, ordinary handyman by her side, Alaric Thorne, is actually an ancient Lycan King who has lived for a thousand years with unmatched power. Cold and ruthless after centuries of loneliness, he reserves his utmost tenderness and adoration.....

items.title: Rules -Based Horror: Highway 404
items.intro: Ex-commander Maggie drives the "Steel Rhino" into Highway 404, ruled by supernatural rules. With a survival squad, she fights violence with violence, destroys the highway, and hunts down "Rule Makers" in the real world.

items.title: Black Bite Marks
items.intro: Bankrupt heiress Elena marries underboss Adrian to save her father. Amid betrayal and assassins, Adrian learns she saved him from a fire seven years ago—not Serena. He tears up the contract and kneels with a lifelong vow.

items.title: The Dragon Queen’s Retribution
items.intro: True dragon Sera Vale sacrifices six belly scales to save six kingdoms. Decades later, they break their oath and brand her an evil dragon. Knight Rowan is sent to kill her but uncovers the truth and stands by her. Together they reclaim the scales and reshape the continent.

items.title: The last round
items.intro: Five years ago, the night Leon was crowned world boxing champion, his parents died in a car crash rushing to see him fight—so he quit in guilt and spent five years as a silent janitor at Starlight Boxing Gym, never knowing Elena, its struggling owner, idolized him. When Victor's hitman Bruno comes to seize the gym and Elena, Leon's single punch sends him flying—only to reveal his parents' death was never just an accident.

items.title: Breathe Me In, Mr. Veyne
items.intro: Heiress Elowen once humiliated Cedric. Now bankrupt, she is trapped by him in a contract using her mother’s medical bills. As they clash, they uncover a Veyne family conspiracy and find true love amid suffocating tenderness.

items.title: Curse of the Sleeping Dragon
items.intro: Because her older sister was delivering flowers on Elsa’s behalf, she accidentally stumbled upon the affair between the step-queen and the prince, and was brutally killed in revenge by the step-queen. To take revenge, Elsa accidentally released Nisaros, an evil dragon imprisoned for two thousand years, only to be forcibly possessed by him.

items.title: Borrowed Face, Unmasked Love
items.intro: A genius painter, Audrey, held captive by America's richest man, Damon, for three years, finally escapes — only to beg a plastic surgeon, Ethan, to give her a new face. He agrees. But the face he gives her belongs to his late wife Celeste. Now she's hiding in plain sight as his fake wife. He's supposed to protect her. She's supposed to play along. But the closer they get, the harder it is to tell — does he love her... or the woman she sees in the mirror?

items.title: The Golden Wolf's Exclusive Red Fox
items.intro: At a frozen training camp, poor athlete Joren clashes with wealthy heir Damon. Forced into a bonded recovery program, Damon falls for Joren’s grit but only teases him. At the finals, Damon reveals his journal and confesses—misunderstandings melt, and they step onto the podium together.

items.title: My Billionaire Professor Husband
items.intro: Betrayed and humiliated, college student Chloe has a one-night stand with a stranger and flees. She accepts an arranged marriage—only to discover her cold professor Noah is her one-night stand and secret husband.

items.title: Fatal Muse: Claimed by the Mafia Boss
items.intro: Gifted painter Cesare Scarligi is drugged by his own father and sold to the head of the Grimaldi family, a man with a taste for cruelty. Escaping, he stumbles into the room of mafia godfather Elio Montanari—and at Cesare's own initiative, the two spend the night together. What begins as an accident becomes the bridge that brings them back to each other.

items.title: Lord of Sea Tide: Betray and Return
items.intro: Freya, the Sovereign of the Seas, spent three years living incognito as a ship's physician in her lover's fleet, quietly paving the way for his success. Yet, upon her return, she caught him in a tryst with Sirena—a woman who had been impersonating one of her trusted confidantes. At the Winter Solstice Council, Freya revealed her true identity, reclaimed everything that was hers, and was crowned Queen of the Frozen Seas.

items.title: The Masked Bride
items.intro: 1920s England: con artist Lucy infiltrates Thornfield Manor as a governess to approach reclusive heir Arthur. Both hide secrets, marry, and gradually find true love—facing their pasts and building a real home.

items.title: The Gift of Atlantis
items.intro: Lucan, descendant of Poseidon, is sealed by a marriage contract and humiliated. When the contract burns, he awakens as King of the Seas—turning enemies' anger into power. He crushes fleets, slays sea beasts, and takes revenge on all who betrayed him.

items.title: I Was His Mummy Stepmother
items.intro: Queen Nefra is overthrown, mummified, and sent to Egypt as a gift. Rescued by cold crown prince Seth, she lives under the taboo identity of "pharaoh's new favorite, crown prince's stepmother" while plotting to reclaim her throne—and falling into forbidden love.

items.title: The Protection Deal
items.intro: Alaskan transfer student Irina is bullied after a compliment from the school heartthrob. Saved by "problem boy" Alex, she proposes a fake-girlfriend deal for protection. They go from transaction to true love, expose the truth, and clear Alex's name.

items.title: Professor, Your Student is a Succubus
items.intro: Succubus Vivian hides her identity and contracts with Adrian, but his cold refusal leaves her dying. Mentor Christian’s magic saves her—exposing her secret. She breaks the contract for Christian; jealous Adrian spirals. Caught between two men, whose possession will she fall into?

items.title: The Crown Reborn
items.intro: Alice was cursed by Lucy to remain obese for ten years, betrayed and humiliated by her husband Arthur, and sought to reclaim her dignity only to become deeply entangled in royal court intrigue. After awakening her natural divine power, she must choose between revenge and protecting the continent, as well as reconciling the elves and humans, while also coming to terms with the hurt her son Edward once caused her.

items.title: I Found My Housekeeper Mom a CEO Husband
items.intro: Sama, a single mother working as a hotel cleaner, raises her bright son Leo on her own. Six years ago, she had a one-night encounter with Julian, heir to the Sterling Group, without knowing who he was. Leo unexpectedly signs a temporary father-son agreement with Julian, and a DNA test confirms they are biological father and son. When Sama is hired as a maid in the Sterling household, the two reunite and grow fond of each other......

items.title: Zerg Queen
items.intro: Betrayed and cursed, Elena bonds with the Swarm Hive System. She devours beasts, hatches new units, and ascends from survivor to Zerg Queen. After merging with a Shadow Dragon God, she devours an angel and leads her swarm to the stars.

items.title: My Investor Husband
items.intro: Scarlett keeps her marriage to new investor Ethan a secret at work. They clash over menus by day and burn with passion by night. When exes resurface, their marriage cracks—but Ethan has loved her since high school.

items.title: The Fake Heiress Exposed by Her Own Son
items.intro: The true heiress Maren was hit by the adopted daughter Colette, who underwent a face swap to steal her identity and marry into a wealthy family. Six years later, Maren and Evander’s son Milo uncovers the secret of their lineage through his talent for the violin and an ancestral cufflink. After regaining consciousness, Maren returns with drone evidence. At the family recognition banquet, she exposes the shocking scam......

items.title: The Black Rose Vow
items.intro: In a gothic vampire empire, House Nightshade is framed and slaughtered. Only Selena survives. Ten years later, she returns as a clerk, lures Valentine, and with guard Edmond exposes the plot at the Imperial Council.

items.title: The Duke's Secret Mistress
items.intro: When Frosthold's young lord falls into a coma after an attack, his wife Eshi makes a secret deal with Freman, the city's true ruler, to protect herself—and their arrangement deepens into real love as they face the scheming Oliver together. After the lord wakes and then dies, Eshi flees pregnant to a border town, where Freman silently watches over her for a year—until rebellion brings them together again, and they finally choose to face their feelings.

items.title: The Gorgon
items.intro: Bound by three thousand years of fate, Medusa is reborn as marine archaeologist Dusha—the prophesied maiden destined to bring down the Olympians. Seeking Atlantis to save her brother, she meets Poseidon disguised as a mortal, unaware it's a deadly divine trap—and as the final battle ignites, their reincarnated forbidden love must either be erased by divine authority or finally earn its happy ending.

items.title: The Boy Who Inherited the West
items.intro: Western gunslinger Jake dies protecting ten-year-old Dylan—and wakes in Dylan's body. With the gang divided and enemies closing in, he uses Jake's memories and gun skills to reclaim his father's gang and become the feared ten-year-old gunslinger.

items.title: Sweet Love：My Billionaire Boss is My Twin's Daddy
items.intro: After a one-night encounter leaves Karina pregnant with twins—and believing her son died at birth—she spends years as a single mother fighting to save her sick daughter. A unexpected reunion brings the twins back together and pulls her into the White family's world. With Lexton White by her side, she defeats a ruthless rival, finds her lost son, sends the villain to prison, and finally reclaims everything she thought she'd lost.

items.title: Bottom to Top, Ice on Fire
items.intro: A fallen snowboarding prodigy, Kieran, now a forbearing physio, faces relentless bullying from an arrogant reigning champion Axel — unaware his nemesis has secretly obsessed over him for years. To force the ex-champ back to his peak, Axel orchestrates a high-stakes healing trap while hiding a fatal secret. Together, they conquer life and death, reclaim the summit, and achieve ultimate mutual redemption.

items.title: A Kept Man's Story
items.intro: "Leon Black, an ordinary security guard, accidentally receives supreme cultivation heritage from a mysterious hermit. By chance, he marries Isabella Roman, the CEO of a powerful family, for a monetary contract. Pretending to be an incompetent nobody, Leon hides his overpowered gifts. He fights rival clans, defeats powerful cultivators, masters legendary medical skills, and turns the whole local power circle upside‑down.

items.title: Caged By The Tycoon
items.intro:
Ellio runs the massive Vance empire. When a core code leak erupts, every piece of evidence points to his trusted right-hand man, Harper. In a rage, Ellio has him confined to his estate, where suspicion and raw possessiveness explode without restraint. The truth slowly surfaces: the real leaker is Marcus, an inside man. But the seeds of suspicion have already taken root, and a dangerous bond has tightly entangled them both.
On one side, it’s a cutthroat game of corporate powe.

items.title: Hunting My Alpha Mate
items.intro: Rain, raised by hunters to kill werewolves, is herself a werewolf—and Alpha Ronan’s fated mate. Their love is tested by her adoptive brother Owen, traitor Gideon, and rival Seraphina. They survive the Moon Goddess trial and unite the packs.

items.title: Valkyrie Awakening: No More Sacrifice for Love
items.intro: Valkyrie Brunhilde swore never to use her divine powers to marry the hero Sigurd. Seven years later, he chooses Princess Gundhild—even after she kills their unborn child. Betrayed, Brunhilde drinks deadly serpent venom, leaving him only a farewell note. As regret consumes Sigurd, a new king arrives, willing to defy death for her. But if she returns, who will win her heart?

items.title: My GF Turned Into a Cat
items.intro: Plus-size comic artist Ella secretly loves neighbor Leo. After drawing herself in his arms with a magic pen, she wakes as a chubby cat in his bed. Her attempts to communicate are misread as a cat in heat—and Leo books her a spay surgery.

items.title: Seducing the Untouchable Duke
items.intro: To avenge her sister, Viola infiltrates the Duke's mansion as a maid. Under the cruel Duchess's nose, she reads forbidden texts in a language only she and the Duke understand, dragging the untouchable Duke Howard into obsessive desire. She uses him to destroy the Duchess—then binds him, burns the estate, and emerges masked as the new Duke...

items.title: My Husband，The Dragon King
items.intro: Everyone mocks Alice, a disgraced wife raising her "bastard kids" in a stable—until the twins' fifth birthday, when the boy sprouts golden dragon horns and the girl grows black wings. When their cruel stepmother throws them into the river, their dragon bloodline awakens, the son searches for their Dragon King father, and the King of the Underworld appears—revealing that the "lowborn" mother and her children are actually the Dragon King's wife and heirs.

items.title: The Captain Wants Me
items.intro: Ethan and Ryan are four-year bitter rivals on the college swim team. A relay trial conflict and misunderstood training logs fuel their fierce hostility. To stop their infighting, their coach binds their grades, scholarships and career prospects, forcing them into intensive paired night training. Constant close contact turns their animosity into lingering attraction.

items.title: The Mage World’s Chosen One
items.intro: True heiress Ada is framed by adopted sister Camilla, who steals her magic ideas. Reborn on the Archmage Trial day, Ada exposes Camilla's forbidden magic, awakens source magic, and summons the ancient fire dragon. She crushes her family emblem and rides away.

items.title: Through Dark to Dawn
items.intro: Claire is trapped in an abusive marriage by her daughter's medical bills. Tycoon Mason offers a deal. After divorce, her daughter's rare gene data draws predators. Claire and Mason fight global capital and open-source the database.

items.title: The Horse Trainer and Her Disabled Billionaire
items.intro: Disabled heir Abel has driven away a hundred servants. Horse trainer Leila takes the job, using horse-training methods to handle his violent temper. She bathes him with a stiff brush, catches his thrown objects, and even slaps a snake dead. Their bickering slowly turns into attraction—and a fierce battle of wills.

items.title: Sound of Cello in the Night
items.intro: Evelyn enters Blackwood Manor as a tuner to clear her late father’s name and take revenge on Victoria. With lover Julian, she exposes Victoria and Edgar’s framing, kidnapping, and abuse—and finds peace.

items.title: Don't Touch Her, Hubby—Your Sister Is Pregnant!
items.intro: A hidden heiress marries beneath her and secretly funds her husband’s luxury empire for five years. But when she and her pregnant sister-in-law return from vacation, his mistress humiliates them in her own store—even locking the pregnant sister-in-law in a dog cage. As her true identity emerges and her childhood friend, the powerful Grant family CEO, steps in, the cheating husband loses everything overnight. Divorce and a stunning comeback—she takes back every cent.

items.title: Hostile Takeover
items.intro: Seven years ago, she was his student, and he was her forbidden secret. Seven years later, she becomes his assistant, and he her superior. On the cutthroat M&A battlefield of a top New York law firm, a game fraught with conflict of interest unfolds. The dangerous attraction creeps from the desk to the negotiation table. She knows well: if she falls for him, she will lose everything at stake.

items.title: After the Divorce, My Three Sisters Would Die for Me
items.intro: To complete his mortal trial, Ethan conceals his true identity and makes a living as a humble fishmonger. He loves his wife Claire Carter wholeheartedly and takes meticulous care of her entire family. Yet Claire, blinded by fame and wealth, scorns her husband’s lowly status. Pressured by her family and wealthy tycoon Marcus Reed, she resolutely divorces Ethan, throws him a $5 million severance package, and casts him out.

items.title: Which Alpha Is My Fated Mate
items.intro: A weak Beta is sent to Obsidian Moon Court Academy and bonds with three top Alphas on day one. The Moon Goddess says only one can save him. As love, desire, and power close in, his sealed bloodline awakens—he was never meant to be chosen.

items.title: Darling, Don’t Fall in Love
items.intro: Tamsin, a single mother, becomes the private caregiver for Ronan, a wheelchair-bound CEO, to raise medical funds for her sick son. As they spend time together day in and day out, feelings grow between them. However, a fake wedding sparks misunderstandings. When her son falls critically ill and needs a blood transfusion, DNA results uncover a secret from four years prior: Ronan is the boy’s biological father. Still......

items.title: Sixty Days to Freeze  One Chance to Survive
items.intro: A global cold snap hits. In his past life, the male lead was framed by Kyle and abandoned by his four biased sisters, freezing to death. Reborn with a system, he builds a bunker and stockpiles supplies. When the apocalypse comes, his sisters beg for help.

items.title: My Clown Husband Is a Billionaire in Disguise
items.intro: On her wedding day, Lila is betrayed by her fiancé. On impulse, she proposes to Leander, a maintenance worker who bursts into the church, and they get married on the spot. Little does she know that he is the heir to a trillion-dollar conglomerate who has long disguised himself as an ordinary employee for fear of losing her. Lila joins the group’s design department on her own merit and rises from assistant to director......

items.title: Moonfall Wolf Ruins
items.intro: Reborn before the massacre, Ryan exposes the spy Oliver, tames the mutant wolf, and bonds with Cedric. They crush the Blood Moon Clan, purify the blood poison, unify the seven clans, and marry.

items.title: Devil's Delivery: Make Demons Cry
items.intro: Pizza boy Julius awakens godlike power during a demon attack. Sabotaged by corrupt Bishop Nicholas, he turns his father's bread knife into Archangel Michael's holy sword. Framed for heresy, he is saved by Michael—his true father. Now Julius must journey into Hell to rescue his dad.

items.title: Dragon Lord's Reborn Contract Bride
items.intro: Reborn after a brutal betrayal, Elven Princess Eileen vows revenge. She rejects the elite red dragon and chooses Kael, a broken-winged black dragon despised as a useless beast. Everyone mocks her, but on their forbidden wedding night, Eileen’s divine blood awakens Kael’s sealed dragon god core. The crippled beast everyone looked down upon reveals his true identity—the Sovereign Dragon King. Now, the ultimate vengeance begins.

items.title: He Was Never Their ATM
items.intro: Adrian Carter wakes as CEO. The original owner spoiled his fiancée Chloe Bishop, who drained him with her accomplice. Awake, he ends the engagement, reclaims the assets she stole over four years, fixes a failed game project, crushes her schemes, and takes full control. A comeback tale.

items.title: Becoming a Chaebol Villainess
items.intro: After losing her corner store to a scam, Ah-rin finds herself reborn as a chaebol villainess in a game. Now one of the richest women in the country, she’s given her main quest: win the affection of two marriage candidates in just 15 days—or die. Can Ah-rin find love and survive this dangerous romance game?

items.title: When the World Froze, He Took Over
items.intro: A sudden global cold wave plunges Earth into an ice age. Temperatures drop to minus dozens or even hundreds. Extreme cold destroys infrastructure, transport, and ecosystems. 95% of humanity dies from cold and hunger. Survivors loot and kill. In the frozen ruins, Logan Cross and Claire Blake struggle to live until Logan rises to rule all.

items.title: A God in a World Gone Mad
items.intro: Ethan Locke is summoned into a mad, Cthulhu-like world. All life has mutated. Humanity cowers in 19 fortress cities, praying to various gods. He wakes as a god but impossibly weak. "This must be a mistake," he thinks. Now he must stitch together a broken world.

items.title: The Bridge That Broke Their Pride
items.intro: Ethan Carter spent everything to build his village a bridge. They repaid him by reporting him for illegal fees—demanding half, or threatening to tear it down. Heartbroken, he tore it down himself. Stranded, they knelt in the rain, begging for another. He gave them a ten-year contract: sign, and the road returns. He led them to millions. When his monument rose, the man who reported him guarded it with a broom: "Touch my benefactor, step over me."

items.title: The Emperor Who Failed to Fail
items.intro: Julian Hawke wakes as the new king of Qian. He binds a Tyrant System: ruin the kingdom to live forever. Easy, right? He lets the queen handle memorials, recalls exiled officials, and makes chaos. But things go wrong—his "bad" moves make the kingdom stronger. Soon, he unites six nations. Clara Carte watches as the tyrant accidentally becomes a conqueror.

items.title: The Doorman Who Ruled the Gods
items.intro: Dylan Hart binds a system and becomes a security guard at Tomson One. His complex is full of SSS-grade horrors that fear him. Earning money makes him stronger. He extorts the Horror Bureau and forces horrors to become his tenants. From bureau elites to foreign exorcists, even an SSSS-grade horror and the God of Horrors, all are his ATMs and fuel. He breaks the world's rules and becomes the true ruler above all gods.

items.title: The Wife Who Was a Weapon
items.intro: Claire Brooks, a bodyguard, marries lawyer Adrian Hayes and hides her job. She finds his mother-in-law hurt and his stepdaughter scared. Adrian is cruel. Claire gathers evidence and exposes him in court. His mother-in-law testifies. He loses his license. Claire stops him. She, the mother-in-law, and the girl leave to live freely.

items.title: The Blood Queen Returns and Rules Them All
items.intro: Selovie enters Starlin Academy as a poor half-blood, secretly the last heir of the Vasquez family. She hunts the truth of her mother's murder, takes on the pureblood princess, and exposes the Council of Elders' criminal empire.

items.title: Storm: The Last Mech Standing
items.intro: When alien beasts threaten humanity, Baek Kang-min, the only pilot capable of controlling the powerful mech Storm, repels the invasion and becomes a hero. Haunted by his parents' deaths, he disappears and joins Kang Min-seo's Revo Clan under a false identity. Two years later, the largest 5S-rank beast horde ever recorded approaches Earth, forcing humanity to call upon its greatest hero once again.

items.title: The Rogue Mermaid
items.intro: Mermaid princess Marina sneaks onto Blackstone Island to find her stolen Heartstone and abducted mother. She meets cursed heir Julian; her touch is his only cure. They strike a symbiosis contract and uncover a dark undersea lab conspiracy.

items.title: The Unfulfilled Vow of the Winter Champion
items.intro: Eren, Northern Fifth Legion Commander, returns to the capital and reunites with Crown Prince Lucien, marked by the “Winter’s Mark”. A supply dispute creates strife. The buried truth of the Old City Purge shatters their romance. Tangled in political betrothals, the White Night Army and throne conflict amid court plots, haunted by past bloodshed, they grow apart yet remain linked. They fight to prove: they are no chains, but the only ones trusted with their ultimate choice.

items.title: Sacrificed to the Dragon, Crowned as His Queen
items.intro: Elena is forced to die in her sister's place on the Dragon Sacrifice Day. But the dragon Kael kneels before her—she carries dragon blood. Crowned Dragon Queen overnight, she refuses her family's pleas and uncovers her hidden origins.

items.title: Too Late, I’m the Billionaire’s Bride
items.intro: Chloe was the Hale brothers’ beloved childhood sweetheart—until their nanny’s daughter stole their hearts and even got both brothers to propose to her. Heartbroken, Chloe chooses to marry Philadelphia’s heir, Liam Reed. But when her wedding day arrives, Ethan and Jasper finally realize the girl they pushed away is really leaving forever. They go completely crazy trying to stop the wedding and win Chloe back.

items.title: Mafia's Billionaire Sweet Wife
