items.intro: Her family dragged Amy home to marry a ruthless mafia boss in their favorite daughter’s place. But when Liam arrives, he kneels, kisses Amy’s hand, and calls her “Boss.” They thought she was disposable. They’re about to learn who really owns this city.

items.title: Twenty-One Days to Break Them All
items.intro: The peak immortal's soul falls into Julian Grant, a waste with no core, mocked by all. Three fiancées break their engagements. He accepts a 21-day bet. With Celia Hart's help, he rebuilds his core, wins the tournament, claims the three women, and is named General. Then he finds his brother's death was a plot and a conspiracy against the throne begins.

items.title: My Ex's Forbidden Brother
items.intro: Maya catches her boyfriend cheating with her stepsister. In a fit of impulse, she throws herself into the arms of Adrian, her ex’s older brother. What she doesn’t know is that this menacing luxury brand CEO is the one who saved her in her childhood—and has restrained his feelings for her for years. As her hidden illness, her mother’s inheritance, and the corporate power struggle all come to light at once, Maya must reclaim command of her body, her career, and her love life.

items.title: I Married a Poor Bodyguard, Only to Discover He' s a Billionaire CEO
items.intro: To save the foster home, Harper must raise $180,000 within 48 hours, only to unexpectedly enter a flash marriage with Declan, a “poor bodyguard.” She has no idea that he is actually the CEO of a billion-dollar empire. As plagiarism schemes, a wealthy love rival, and lies about his identity threaten their contract marriage, Declan ultimately proves his love by risking everything for her.

items.title: Cyberpunk: The Vanishing King of Fighters
items.intro: Twenty years ago, boxing champion V killed Ragna and lost his wife. He hides as a low-rank coach, raising his daughter Gwen. When Gwen is targeted in the ring, V returns and knocks out her opponent in three seconds.

items.title: The Golden Trail
items.intro: Hart Group cracks a treasure map to the Saint Aurelia War Vault. Heiress Evelyn hires legendary gunslinger Wyatt "Dead Eye" as her bodyguard. Together they survive casino traps, snipers, and three crime families to open the golden gate.

items.title: After Being Abandoned, I Married His Boss
items.intro: For seven years, top architect Vivian hid her true identity for Ethan, planning to reveal it and propose at his promotion ceremony. Instead, she discovered he was engaged to socialite Chloe—and had stolen credit for her design. Seeking a fresh start, Vivian entered a one-year marriage agreement with Damian, who needed a legal wife to secure his family trust. As Vivian fights to reclaim her work and career, she and Damian confront her ex, the fake socialite

items.title: The Warmth Of His Tongue
items.intro: Gabrielle, trapped in an abusive marriage to old billionaire Victor, reunites with her ex John, disguised as a repairman. After Victor casts her out and she faces betrayal and auction danger, John saves her. His Rothschild heir identity is revealed. Victor collapses, and John proposes with a priceless pink diamond. Gabrielle chooses true love over fortune.

items.title: My Sugar Baby Is the Elven King
items.intro: After catching her husband Nate in bed with her stepsister Lily, Charlotte swears off love and keeps a penniless elven student, Alexander, as her kept man for three years—until Nate returns with a pregnant Lily and she hands Alexander a ten-million-gold breakup check. But at a royal banquet, Charlotte discovers the poor student she dismissed is actually the Elf King—and though he accepted her money, he has no intention of letting his beloved benefactor walk away.

items.title: Wrong Groom True Love: Don's Sweetheart
items.intro: Claire, an heiress of the Rothschild family, marries into the Mafia’s family after mistaking the token; on her wedding night, she catches her husband having an affair with his sister-in-law, Isabella. She secretly saves Dante—the eldest son and the "Godfather", only to discover that Dante is the true owner of the token and the father of her unborn child. As conspiracies and deceptions are unmasked, the brothers turn against each other, and true love ultimately prevails.

items.title: Catch Me
items.intro: After saving arrogant A-lister Xavier Vance from a freezer, Clara becomes the obsession of the one man who won't take no for an answer—he protects her, destroys her enemies, and when she stands on a freezing bridge, he waits below: "If you jump, I'll catch you." Hunted by cameras and crushed by debt, a desperate girl and a lonely superstar risk everything to become each other's salvation.

items.title: Falling for My Cheating Husband's Stepson
items.intro: After discovering her husband Julian's decade-long double life—showering his mistress Vanessa and stepson Simon with love while plotting to seize her family fortune—Sophia refuses to be a victim. Becoming an art instructor at Simon's university, she seduces him as the ultimate pawn to dismantle Julian's hypocrisy, crush his scheme, and destroy Vanessa—then walks away with her son Finn to start a peaceful new life.

items.title: Turns Out My Mom Is the Mafia Godmother
items.intro: Mafia godmother Catherine finds her twin sister dying of cancer. She poses as her sister to raise her three children—and discovers her sister was poisoned by her husband and his mistress. Catherine will make them pay.

items.title: The Wife They Threw Away Came Back a Queen
items.intro: Ivy, Green Valley's most gifted disciple, marries for love but suffers three years of abuse. Betrayed by husband Ash and his "sister" Luna, she loses her child. Her senior disciples return to back her. She regains her healing magic, exposes conspiracies, and reclaims her glory.

items.title: The Adopted Daughter Came Back Powerful
items.intro: Mute rancher Martha and Frank take in abused orphan Lily and raise her to Frontier Edge's Chief Architect. Their son Ethan frames the couple to steal the ranch's $2.8M and throws them out beaten. At his birthday gala Lily reveals her title and brings the heir to his knees. In a warehouse Frank takes a bullet for the son who betrayed him—chosen love outweighs blood.

items.title: He Divorced Me, The Mafia Wanted Me
items.intro: Mafia heir Leonardo learns his stored sperm was used without consent. At the hospital, he meets Sophia, weak after her fifth IVF. She’s married and hoping for a baby with her husband—but she’s carrying Leonardo’s mafia blood. A fated reunion begins.

items.title: My Ex is the Undefeated Champion
items.intro: Nora fakes an affair to push Roman away after her cancer diagnosis, raising their daughter alone. Eight years later, Roman returns as a champion—and Nora is the doctor who must sign his clearance. He hates her; she hides their child.

items.title: The Fallen Sea Queen Was Their God
items.intro: Sea Queen Isa, daughter of the Sea God, is betrayed by the Four Kings after Saint Viola frames her. Stripped of title and cast into the abyss, she transforms into a sea monster. Her divine power has yet to awaken.

items.title: She Took My Place, I Took a God
items.intro: Priestess Kassandra is betrayed by fiancé and sister, falling into the abyss with her newborn. Reborn, she becomes the priestess, unites with gatekeeper Alexios, and bears triplets. She exposes the conspiracy, seals the abyss, and is crowned beside Alexios.

items.title: The Billionaire's Surrogate Wife
items.intro: Livia becomes a secret surrogate bride for Stellan Campbell—ten million dollars to bear his child. Stellan is cold and possessive; Livia is proud and stubborn. As they clash, danger closes in from his uncle Magnus. When she discovers she is pregnant, she walks away—and Stellan realizes too late what he has lost.

items.title: The Rejected White Dragon Bride: Awakening the Queen's Blood
items.intro: Orphan Leah has a rare white dragon bloodline and is despised by her clan. Her lover Cylon secretly despises her, and on his wedding day to Ella, Leah is publicly humiliated and left to die. In desperation, she awakens her progenitor bloodline—she is the supreme Dragon Queen. Golden dragon prince Leon kneels before her.

items.title: The Billionaire's Superhuman Maid
items.intro: Horse trainer Cassana takes a triple-salary job caring for disabled heir Braden, who has driven away a hundred servants. Her horse-training methods—bathing him with a stiff brush, catching thrown vases, slapping a snake dead—infuriate and fascinate him. As they fall in love, rivals Bella and Carl plot against them.

items.title: Return of the True Heiress
items.intro: Sophia is Liam's mistress for three years, resembling his late love. She is the true Smith heiress; Luna stole her identity. After revenge, Liam dies homeless, Luna is jailed, and Sophia builds a charity with reborn Jay.

items.title: My Husband Is The Strongest Wolf King
items.intro:
Reborn on wedding day, the jealous sister steals the eagle chief!
Everyone mocks Lila for marrying the feared Snake Clan leader.
But her husband hides a huge secret: he is the almighty Wolf King, ruler of all beasts.
After they consummate their marriage, he’s about to reveal his true form…

items.title: Blackstone Covenant
items.intro: Undercover cop Ava infiltrates Blackstone Syndicate to steal the ledger from leader Elena Thorne. Elena draws her close; Ava struggles between duty and forbidden love while surviving ambushes and lies.

items.title: Reborn as the Exiled Wolf King’s Mate
items.intro: Aria, a deer clan girl, reincarnates to escape her fatal fate. She diverts danger to her sister Bianca but accidentally forms an unbreakable soul blood pact with Ronan, the imprisoned true wolf prince. Together they fight evil, overthrow conspirators and build a new multi‑race empire.

items.title: Everyone Laughed at My Dad  Until He Saved the World
items.intro: Archmage Arthur hides as a janitor at St. Grace Academy. His son Lucas sees him as a drunken failure. When dark forces return and the Void God emerges, Arthur's identity is revealed. Lucas matures, gains love, and takes up the mission to protect the world.

items.title: Golden Thunder: The Archmage Returns
items.intro: The strongest archmage Aurelian dies ending darkness, then wakes as the bullied waste Rowan. As golden thunder returns, a familiar dark force approaches. His rebirth may be fate—or a larger crisis.

items.title: Her Secret Lycan King
items.intro: Lyra is about to be exiled for her "cursed" wolf unless she finds a legal mate overnight. The mysterious man she rescued agrees to marry her. Their fake marriage becomes real—and she slowly realizes her omega husband is the missing Alpha King, Caius.

items.title: THE SILENCE REMEMBERS
items.intro: Marina, hiding her heiress identity, married Dr. Eli and raised their daughter, Siniang. When Siniang was dying, Eli altered the heart transplant records to save his first love Sophia's son, killing his own daughter. Grieving, Marina revealed her identity, became hospital director, and exposed Eli's betrayal and medical fraud. She defeated Sophia and Eli with evidence, then healed with her childhood friend Alvin, turning her love for Siniang into saving more children.

items.title: Valkyrie: The God of War's Rebirth
items.intro: As Ragnarok approaches, the Norse Valkyrie, Valkyrie, grows tired of endless wars and chooses to seal her divine powers, living in the North as a mortal named 'Lynn.' She hides her identity and marries the demigod Hakon, hoping to enjoy a peaceful life. But on the eve of their wedding, she catches her fiancé Hakon having an affair with the Frost Giant spy Vera, and worse, the two frame her as a spy for the Frost Giants, leaving her in a desperate situation.

items.title: Dragon's Covenant
items.intro: Elrowen, last heir of House Veral, is betrayed and sacrificed to Ancient Dragon Peak. Her blood awakens the purple-crystal dragon Chirion. Bound by soul contract, they reclaim her honor, expose the Grand Elder, and rebuild Violet Manor.

items.title: The Prisoner's Queen
items.intro: Heiress Chloe is framed by her fiancé and stepsister, imprisoned in a private prison. The warden Arturo who saves her is the bodyguard she once sent to prison three years ago. They join forces to fight back and reclaim her empire.

items.title: Slacking Off to Save the Empire
items.intro: Ethan Cole, a modern office worker, transmigrates as a Ming imperial guard. He awakens a Slacker System: slack at work, invincible after hours. After killing a demon elder, he's sent to the Entertainment Bureau. There he recruits assassin Selena Ward and meets the emperor. Using after-work power and office tricks, he beats corrupt officials and demons. He defeats the demon lord, but oil discovery forces him to work overtime again in the west.

items.title: Checked In Among the Dead
items.intro: Evan Grant, cursed with energy, takes a job at the haunted inn. The staff and most guests are ghosts. With Mia Harlow, he faces ghost scams, enters the ghost market, fights the Dark Elder, and helps the Lamp Keeper. He stabilizes his yin veins and finds belonging at the inn.

items.title: From Kept Woman to Market Queen
items.intro: Vivian Grant spent three years as Ethan Hale's kept woman mocked by his daughter. No one knows she was once the top regulator of the Global Capital Order, whose signature could move half the financial market. When twelve offshore groups short-sell Ethan's company, she returns to finance and saves it.

items.title: The Kindness That Came Full Circle
items.intro: Ten years ago, poor student Adrian Kane worked at Claire Clarke's noodle shop. Unable to pay tuition, he planned to give up college. Claire noticed—and quietly left him a bowl of hot soup and money. A decade later, Adrian returns with a business empire. He finds Claire's shop threatened by a developer. To repay her kindness, he fights back, exposes the developer's crimes, and rewrites the rules. The shop is reborn, and kindness passes on.

items.title: Revenge of the Hidden Mafia Heiress
items.intro: Francesca, sole heiress of the ruthless Moretti mafia empire, hid her identity for eight years to marry penniless Julian and secretly build his company from nothing. On their anniversary, she discovers his affair with Elena—the very orphan she had sponsored. The gentle wife vanishes; the mafia princess awakens. Behind her stand four brothers who spoil her rotten: whatever she wants, the whole family makes it happen.

items.title: THE DAUGHTER OF THE SEA
items.intro: On her wedding day, Sera's childhood sweetheart tears up their engagement and marries her cousin. She spends a night with a mysterious CEO, then disappears. She discovers her blood is that of a sea-god's daughter—and destroys her uncle's family.

items.title: Shadowmage The Hunter’s Revenge
items.intro: Legendary bounty hunter Valen seals his power after his wife's murder and becomes a drunken outcast. Assigned to teach Princess Elara shadow magic, he uncovers a conspiracy behind his wife's death. When a beast tide attacks the capital, Valen reclaims the name "Shadow" and completes his revenge.

items.title: The Family He Almost Missed
items.intro: Claire Carter shared an unexpected night with Ethan Hayes. A butler’s mistake let her friend take her place. Claire raised their twins alone for five years. She later joined Ethan’s firm. Suspecting her of gold-digging, Ethan opposed her at first but fell for her. Her jealous friend schemed against her. Truth emerged, Claire gained true love, and the family reunited.

items.title: They Left Him Nothing but the Sea
items.intro: Evan Stone spent three years at sea with his uncle, only to be paid eight thousand. He cut ties, but his parents fell ill, needing a hundred sixty thousand for treatment. In desperation, he found his grandfather's bronze chest and an ancient book about the Golden Sea. To save his parents, he set out into the deadly sea, gambling his life for a future.

items.title: A Promise Kept Across Three Realms
items.intro: Nina Crowe sets out with a jade pendant from her father to find her family. Along the way, she meets four loving guardians and a cute hedgehog, Rollie. Together they face dangers, protect each other, and finally rescue her trapped father. Reunited, they begin a warm, happy life full of love.

items.title: The Secret Sauce They Couldn't Steal
items.intro: In the 1990s, Ethan Carter helped run his family's braised food stall with a secret recipe. His parents gave the stall and recipe to his older brother and kicked him out. His girlfriend left too. With only savings, he restarted, using his unique recipe and honest work. From a street stall, he built a chain, became a millionaire, and helped others.

items.title: Rise to Reign, The Alpha Princess Awakens
items.intro: Denise, a low-ranking Omega with no wolf soul, supports her comatose mother through underground boxing. In crisis, she awakens a rare white wolf bloodline—learning she is the missing queen's royal princess. She fights traitors and is crowned Alpha Queen.

items.title: The Baby Who Shook the World
items.intro: Three-year-old Nina Wynn is forced by her mother to find her father. She steals wild fruit, destroys bullies, storms the Cold Moon Sect, and even yells at the cold-faced Lord. But when he sees her mother's jade pendant, he recognizes her mother and protects Nina, breaking sect rules. The toddler demands to know the truth. A hilarious, mysterious family-seeking journey begins.

items.title: The Dead Man's Shopping Channel
items.intro: Ethan Reed, a struggling graduate, dies and wakes in the Underworld, whose economy has collapsed. He proposes livestream shopping, builds a ghost crew with Sasha Vale, and sells underworld goods to the living. He revives the economy, helps humans, expands cross-realm business, extends his lifespan, and becomes the Underworld's Sales King.

items.title: When the Demon Came for the Bell
items.intro: Felix Ward, a mad monk, kills the Ox-Bone Black Dragon. The dragon's daughter, Vivian Raven, steals the Soul-Returning Golden Bell to avenge him. Felix fights to stop her and protect the land. Corrupt men help demons. Battles unfold: a bowl becomes treasure, paper wives turn real, locust spirits block roads, ghosts take bodies, and traps await at temple. Good versus evil.

items.title: Captain of Her Own Storm
items.intro: Claire Stone risks her life in a tsunami to haul in a full catch, only to be paid a pittance. She buys a second-hand boat, the Breaking Waves, and with her crew braves deadly waters. Using skill and courage, she lands a fortune in fish. Despite her adoptive father's cruelty and life-threatening storms, she stays true to herself and forges her own path at sea.

items.title: He Came Back from the Abyss
items.intro: Ethan Hayes finds a huge bluefin tuna school. As the crew prepares for a rich harvest, an undersea earthquake triggers a tsunami warning. He chooses to abandon the catch to save lives, clashing with the investor who insists on fishing. As giant waves close in, Ethan shoulders the burden of life and death, holding the line at sea.

items.title: She Farmed a Miracle
items.intro: Chloe Hart, a brilliant medical doctor, transmigrates into a famine year and is sold to marry a comatose man. Her lab space comes with her. She uses modern science to make rain, grow crops, and find treasures. With Miles Carter, she lifts her new family from poverty to prosperity, buying land, building homes, planting herbs, and opening shops. Everyone dotes on her.

items.title: Last in Class, Last One Standing
items.intro: When a zombie outbreak traps everyone inside a top high school, Logan Pierce thinks he's doomed—until he discovers a bug: zombies don't eat the dumb and the slow. As the school's worst student, he survives every danger while his honors-student friends get hunted. Mia Reed watches as the deadliest place becomes his safest playground.

items.title: Royal lust on the run
items.intro: Rebels breach the royal city. Young Queen Elena flees with old King Roland and his adult stepson Adrian. In the rain, Adrian teases and gropes his stepmother inside the carriage—while the king drives outside, unaware.

items.title: Zombie World Delivery Man
items.intro: In an ordinary real-world reality, an accidental connection opens to a zombie-infested dimension. Ethan Reed, a food-delivery rider, is unexpectedly transported to this apocalyptic world. He obtains a piece of gold through a food-delivery trade. From then on, Ethan starts traveling back and forth between the two worlds, amassing massive quantities of gold. His huge gold holdings draw protection from a secret organization, launching a cross-temporal operation.

items.title: The Heretic Inside the Holy City
items.intro: Seth is cast into the mist and merges with a heavenly fragment, becoming a monster. Disguised as a believer, he returns to the Holy City and confronts God—only to find the city is a cage and its people are livestock.

items.title: The General's Lethal Surgeon
items.intro: A trauma surgeon wakes in 1923 as Elena Sinclair, trapped in a political marriage. Her husband Victor schemes against her family, but the Sinclair Trust built his career. She will expose deception and restore justice.

items.title: They All Betrayed Me, Now They Lost Everything
items.intro: Claire Hayes’ premarital fully‑paid home is taken over by husband Evan Carter’s family. Pushed into premature labor, she is neglected by his son‑biased family. Claire sells the house to a tough buyer, leaving the Carters homeless. She moves to a luxury postpartum center with the sale money. Their fraudulent property claims are exposed online. Kneeling for mercy, Evan gets fired by Claire: Some mistakes can never be forgiven.

items.title: A Fateful Encounter That Changed Everything
items.intro: Five years ago, construction worker Ethan Foster encountered framed Larkin Group chairwoman Vivian Larkin, who gave herself to him in a daze. Years later, pressured by his adoptive family into an arranged marriage, Ethan turned it down when his daughter Lily Foster appeared. Blaming Lily as a burden, his adoptive family threatened to disown them. Meanwhile, Vivian flew home from abroad to support Ethan and Lily.

items.title: Sweet Bride, Savage Bandit
items.intro: Ace attorney Diana Weller wakes as a disaster‑warding bride. Her groom dies before their wedding, leaving her with her mother‑in‑law and sister‑in‑law. She accidentally becomes a mountain bandit chief. When she tries to go straight, she meets governor Ethan Hale, who is there to crush the outlaws. A mishap entangles them. She comes home to find Ethan waiting, eyeing her suspiciously. She feigns meekness, unaware he knows her secret. He closes in and sets traps to snare her.

items.title: Second Chance, Better Choice
items.intro: After bankruptcy, Ethan Crane's wife divorced him. He tried to jump but woke up in college. On the day he once confessed to his ex-wife, he instead confessed to campus beauty Claire Ward who is actually an heiress. He rebuilds his life, starts businesses, and falls for Claire. His ex-wife, who once saw him as a simp, cries with regret.

items.title: The Broken Oath of a Betrayed Defender
items.intro: Empress Xayen of Evan Pryce pursues immortality and trusts the demonic Everlife Sect. Following their scheme to steal lifespan via 99 abducted 3‑9‑year‑old children, she seizes kids who vanish, as the cult feeds on their essence and corrupts the court. Hero Caleb Frost is framed as incompetent. Crushed, he abandons Evan Pryce.

items.title: Kill Me, Save the Dynasty
items.intro: Evan Cole, a modern youth, transmigrates to Ming Dynasty as a low-ranking official. To activate a system and return home, he must be reasonably executed by the emperor. Meanwhile, the emperor binds a system and travels , witnessing the dynasty's fall. As Evan tries madly to die, the emperor becomes interested in his wild claims to save the empire.

items.title: Fated to Knock on His Door
items.intro: Ava Linden, a young Taoist nun seeking immortality, keeps dreaming of a man she loves. Her master tricks her: to ascend, she must face a love tribulation. He points to a photo of Adrian Stone. Believing him, Ava leaves the mountain to marry Adrian.

items.title: The Pawn Who Played the King
items.intro: Claire Morgan was betrayed by her husband, who tricked her into sleeping with Emperor Damon Rowan. In return, his family rose while she was shamed and her daughter died. She killed him and then woke up on that same night, reborn. This time, she uses the emperor as her weapon to make them all pay.

items.title: He Was Ready for the End
items.intro: Ethan Cole gets a warning call from his father: "On Mid-Autumn Festival, don't look at the moon. Lock your doors and windows." He ignores it and plays horror games. His wife packs snacks. Then the horror begins.

items.title: The Lost Galactic Son
items.intro: When Atherin falls to the treacherous Void Lord, infant prince Caelen Vance is smuggled to a remote world and raised in secret. Twenty-six years later, the gifted heir heads to Orisa for answers, where he joins courageous Liyana Ryder in a lethal succession trial. As their fake engagement turns real, Caelen must reclaim his Star Core, awaken his imperial power, and defeat the tyrant who murdered his family before Orisa is destroyed.

items.title: Sold to the Dragon King with His Secret Baby
items.intro: Mira secretly carries the child of Theron, heir to the Dragon Clan, after a one-night stand. But her greedy parents force her to marry his younger brother Julian, the "Frenzied Dragon". When villains Vivienne and Ignis expose her pregnancy, Theron publicly claims Mira and the baby, crushing their schemes. Torn apart again before their wedding, Mira is rescued by Theron and Julian together. To prove his love, Theron gives the throne to Julian and finally marries Mira.

items.title: The Billionaire's Hidden Beauty
items.intro: Forced to become a billionaire’s stand-in wife, scar-faced Emilia hides her breathtaking beauty beneath a disguise. But when her secret is exposed, everyone expects her to be humiliated—only to watch this “ugly girl” unleash her hidden talents and rise to the top! And the billionaire?

items.title: Alpha Single Daddy's Unwanted Nanny
items.intro: Falsely accused Omega Jade leaps from a tower and lands in Alpha King Kael's carriage, triggering their fated mate bond. She flees, pregnant with his child, only to have her baby stolen. Years later, she becomes her own daughter's nanny in Kael's castle. Hidden identities, swapped relics, and dangerous wolf‑magic swirl—will their buried truth ever surface?

items.title: The Pharaoh's Legacy: Awakening of the Boy Heir
items.intro: Zane, a lowly slave of Thebes's Faris household, awakens the sealed soul of Pharaoh Thutmose III and the power of the Sun God. Enduring his family's cruelty and deadly trials, he rises step by step, crushes his rivals, and reclaims the throne of Egypt, while a long-buried traitor stirs beneath the temple, waiting to strike again.

items.title: Reborn: I Contracted the Deep-Sea Lord
items.intro: Marina escaped gilded noble shackles and married a ragged fisherman. No one knew he ruled the furious ocean. When bitter betrayal dragged her toward death by fire, dark storm‑clouds rolled in. As flames blazed, towering tsunami waves roared shore‑ward. Who exactly was the man she trusted?

items.title: The Mistress Was His Mom
items.intro: Influencer Jenna mistakes Julian’s mother Eve for his dead ex Iris and abuses her live. Julian exposes the truth, cancels the wedding, and Jenna later kidnaps and drugs Eve—leading to a deadly warehouse explosion.

items.title: Wicked Craving Claimed by the Monster
items.intro: Witch Aurora is poisoned mute by her sister and sacrificed to a cursed beast in Blackstone Forest. The monster is actually the betrayed true prince, Xavier. Awakening a voiceless holy light, Aurora tames the beast and forms a soul pact. Together they march on the capital for revenge.

items.title: Zero Mech: Rise of the Janitor Ace
items.intro: Janitor Zeke, son of a criminal, is humiliated at the elite armor base. When a giant beast disables all AI mechs, he pilots a sealed first-generation pure mech and becomes a legend.

items.title: I Found An Evil Soulmate from Hell
items.intro: Lisa loses everything in one day and accidentally awakens Lucifer, the King of Hell. She carries his missing soul fragment—the key to his power. Bound together, they face love, betrayal, and the fate of Heaven and Hell.

items.title: The Alpha's Secret Daughter
items.intro: Elena gave Damon her kidney and her blood, then let his mother drive her away so the healing ritual could save him, walking out pregnant and cutting their Bond. Five years on, the Alpha heir is back, and so are the relatives who want her daughter's bloodline. Elena will not be pushed aside twice.

items.title: The Abandoned Son Becomes the Mecha King
items.intro: Abandoned as a child, Kayn grew up in the slums as a mecha prodigy. After finding a mysterious cube holding the key to humanity's fate, he rises from a scrap-metal mecha to crush the arena, beat his adoptive rival, and confront the father who never accepted him. When insect swarms invade, he pilots the Titan to end the war and lead humanity.
